rgyu dang / bzo grwa khag la rtog zhib byed rgyu de chags/ de ltar byed skabs phan tshun go brda gsal po ma 'phrod pa dang / bzo grwas kha gdan gyi spus tshad dang tshos gzhi/che chung sogs mngags cha byas pa ltar mi byed pa sogs kyi dka' ngal 'phrad par ma zad/ dmigs bsal dus thog tu ma tshar ba'i dka' ngal yang yang 'phrad/ de bzhin skal bzang bkra shis kyis kha gdan gyi rin 'bab rnams phyi phyogs nyo tshong las khungs

296 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/la zla ba gsum dang drug /tha na de bas ring ba'i dus yun gyi rjes su ma gtogs mi sprod par brten/ phyi phyogs nyo tshong las khungs kyis kyang bzo grwa khag la sprod rgyu dus 'gyangs phyin pa bcas mdor na des las don tshang mar 'gor rkyen chags te/ bkra shis tshe ring gi las kur dka' tshegs chen po byung /de ltar yang kha gdan gyi tshong las de gzhi rtsa'i char yag po byung /'on kyang lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i nang skal bzang bkra shis dang bkra shis tshe ring gnyis mnyam du khran thur bskyod skabs/ khong gnyis kyis khrom ra dang sger pa'i sa nas kha gdan rnying ma sgam bzhi nyos shing / skabs der bkra shis tshe ring gis de rigs phyi rgyal la 'khyer na khrims 'gal yin pa shes kyi med/ gnam thang la slebs skabs khong gnyis bkag 'gog byas te nyin gang dri gcod byas te kha gdan rnams gzhung bzhes byas pas/ skal bzang bkra shis hong kong la song ba dang bkra shis tshe ring lha sar log yong / don der brten nas bkra shis tshe ring ngo tsha kha skyengs chen po byung zhing / lha sar slebs rjes phyi phyogs nyo tshong las khungs kyis kyang khong bskongs nas dri brtsad byas/ 'on kyang ya mtshan pa zhig la skal bzang bkra shis kyis pe cing du bca' sdod a ri'i gzhung tshab dang rang gi ngo shes yin pa'i rgya gzhung gi gnad yod las byed brgyud de khrin tu gnam thang nas kha gdan rnying ma rnams phyir blangs te/ mtha' ma phyi rgyal la dbor thub pa byung / de'i thog nas bkra shis tshe ring gis khong pa rang gi bsam tshod byas pa las rnyog zing che ba'i tshong pa zhig yin pa shes shing / de bzhin khong pa'i rnyog zing che ba'i las ku'i bkod mngags khag cig bkra shis tshe ring gis sgrub stangs mi shes skabs/ kho pa khong khro langs 'gro ba dang phan tshun dbar kha rtsod kyang thengs kha shas byung /skal bzang bkra shis kyi byed stangs la zhib par blta skabs/ khong pa legs grub ldan pa'i tshong pa zhig yin yang bod dang bod mi/ bod kyi tshong las bcas la phan thogs byed mkhan gyi mi zhig min pa rtogs/ kho pas srid gzhung dang bzo grwar 'brel ba byas te kha gdan dang bal khrom ra'i gong tshad las dma' ba nyo thub pa byung ste phyi rgyal la rin gong ha cang mtho por btsong nas khe 'bab chen po bzo thub kyang des bzo pa dang bzo grur khe phan de tsam ma thob par ma zad/ mtha' ma bod nang kho rang sger gyi kha gdan bzo grwa btsugs te sa gnas kyi bzo grwa'i tshong las la skyon bzos/ rgyu mtshan de dag la brten bkra shis tshe ring gis kho pa dang mnyam las byed mtshams bzhag 'dug /dus yun gang tsam ring skal bzang bkra shis dang mnyam las byas par brten nas bkra shis tshe ring gis kha gdan gyi tshong las dang / phyi rgyal du gtong phyogs/ rgya gzhung gi 'brel

lhan thabs dang po/ 297yod las khungs dang tshan pa khag gi mi snar 'brel ba byed phyogs sogs shes yod par brten/rang ngos nas kha gdan gyi tshong las gnyer te khe 'bab rnams slob grwa gsar 'dzugs byed rgyur btang 'dug cing /de'i thad phyi rgyal ba ngo shes mang pos rogs ram byas 'dug /le'u bzhi pa/ yul lung mang po'i grogs po rnam pas bkra shis tshe ring gi slob grwar rgyab skyor gnang ba/༄༅// le'u 'di'i nang slob grwa'i gron dngul gyi rgyab rten gnyis pa phyi rgyal grogs po mang pos rogs ram gnang tshul bkod 'dug cing / de yang gcig nas bkra shis tshe ring gis bod dbyin rgya gsum gyi skad yig shes pa dang / gnyis nas tshong las gnyer skabs 'grul skyod mang po byed dgos par brten/ rang bzhin gyis ngo shes mang po byung ba/ gsum nas nub phyogs yul khag tu bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gzhung la dga' mos byed mkhan mang du song bar brten/ bod la yul skor du yong mkhan je mang du song ba dang / de rigs la bkra shis tshe ring gi slob grwa'i las gzhi ngo sprod byed skabs mang po zhig gis rogs ram byas 'dug /rogs ram byed mkhan khongs stes dbang gis kha gdan bzo grwa nas thug pa'i slob dpon chen mo mo re (970625507 70072) dang / hpha ran si'i rgyal sa pe ri se gtsug lag slob khang gi shar phyogs skad yig gi slob dpon chen mo bod skad chu rgyug rgyug smra thub mkhan ni ko la se khor na ḍi re (97052550( kho nga'iX/2510lung 3zung0) sogs dang / 'jar man gyi so'i sman pa bhe ri ji ṭi a ran se dang / sman pa ri ta sogs shar nub kyi mi sems bzang mang pos dngul dngos kyi rgyab skyor ji ltar byas tshul khag cig dpe mtshon gyi tshul du bkod 'dug cing / de'i khongs kyi kha shas dngos gnas yid dbang 'phrog dgos pa 'dug kyang yig tshogs la 'jigs te 'dir ma bris/le'u lnga pa/ srid don dri bar nges par gdong gtad dgos pa/༄༅// le'u 'di'i nang thog mar rnam gling rdzong gi slob gso las khungs kyi mig dmar gyis mkho sprod byas pa'i gsham gsal gnas tshul bkod 'dug /de yang phyi lo 1990 gong du rdzong der slob

298 pha yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/chung khyen bsdoms 74 las med cing / de dag mang che ba'i spus tshad la skyon yod/ phyi lo 1990nas 2000 lo'i bar bkra shis tshe ring gis rdzong der slob grwa 53 gsar 'dzugs byas shing / de dag gi spus tshad ni rgyal khab kyis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i tshad gzhi dang mthun pa'am de las lhag pa byung yod/ phyi lo 1990 lor rdzong der slob lo son pa'i byis pa 6718 yod kyang / de'i khongs nas byis pa 2520 ste brgya cha 37 tsam ma gtogs slob grwar 'dzul zhugs thub med/ phyi lo 2000 lor slob lo son pa'i byis pa 10056 yo da pa'i khongs nas khyen byis pa 8507 slob zhugs byas yod pas/des brgya cha 8(hril po zin yod/der brten slob grwa de dag btsugs pa la brten nas phan 'bras mngon gsal thon yod pa de rtsod pa med pa zhig red/'on kyang las gzhi 'di rigs bod la yongs su phan thogs yod pa zhig yin min thad thog ma nas dogs 'dri byung zhing / de ni phyi lo 1998 lor brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pa khag cig gis bcar 'dri byas pa las legs par mtshon thub/de yang lo de'i phyi zla 6tshes 3nyin rgya gzhung gi bkod sgrig 'og brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pa bcu bzhi tsam bkra shis tshe ring gi khyim du yong nas bcar 'dri byas shing / gsar 'god pa'i khongs su si bhi e se ((85) dang an bhi si/ (766) ḍab li'u 'i yin (7577) sogs yod cing / gsar 'god pa gcig gis ((bkra shis tshe ring lags/ rgya gar nang gi tā la'i bla ma'i rjes 'brang nga/ khag cig khong gis bod kyi gnad don thad 'dzin pa'i 'tshe med zhi ba dang dbu ma'i lam gyi srid byus la ma 'dod pa byung ste/ drag po'i ngo bor 'gyur gyi red bsam gyi e 'dug nyi ces dris/ de la bkra shis tshe ring gis yud tsam khu sim mer bsdad de (thung rang dngos gnas dri ba der lan 'debs pa'i gnas babs thog med nyi ces bshad/ de nas gsar 'god pa gzhan zhig gis btsan byol bod mi'i spyi tshogs nang mi mthun pa yod med dris pa dang / yang gcig gis na rgya nag gzhung gis ci'i phyir paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid kyi gnad don spyad de tā la'i bla mar kha gtad gcog gi yod red/ des bod kyi bla ma tsho'i nang 'gal zla gsar pa bzo ba ma red dam 〉〉zer/ de dag la bkra shis tshe ring ga lab 'di lab med par gyur te yud tsam bsdad rjes spyo dgongs dag /'di ni ga re 'byung bzhin pa de ga red 〉〉ces bshad pas tshang ma gad mo shor/de nas bud med cig gis spyo khyed rang gis shes yon gal chen yin par bsam don ci yin nyi zhes dris par da gzod bkra shis tshe ring gis the tshom med par rang gis slob grwa 'dzugs don ni/ go skabs ma thob pa'i phru gu skyo bo tshor slob sbyong gi go skabs sprad de/ khrom ra'i dpal 'byor gtso bor byed pa'i 'gran rtsod che ba'i deng rabs kyi spyi tshogs nang mi tshe

lhan thabs dang po/ 299yag po zhig bskyal rgyu yong ched yin/ shes yon ni mi sger so so'i 'tsho ba yar rgyas yong min dang / bod kyi 'byung 'gyur gyi gtso gnad red sogs bshad/ der mthud de bud med cig gis yang ((deng rabs can du 'gyur rgyu'i ched du khyed rang so so'i rig gzhung blos gtong byed 'dod yod dam nyi zhes dris/ dri ba de ni bkra shis tshe ring la mtshon na rnyog 'dzing che ba zhig tu mngon/ khong gis rang nyid bod kyi rig gzhung gi dgra bo yin par khas len byed kyi med/bkra shis tshe ring gi ngos nas bod deng rabs can du bsgyur 'dod yod la/ de ltar bsgyur skabs sngon ma'i byed stangs 'ga' zhig blos gtong byed dgos/ kho rang rgya nag gi srid byus dang de lag bstar byed phyogs la long mchongs kyi rgyab skyor byed mkhan zhig min/ 'on kyang khong gis bod dang rgya nag gi da yod 'brel ba'i khrod kyi bzang cha ngan cha gnyis ka ste dngos yod gnas stangs dang len byas pa yin/ 'brel ba 'di'i khrod khong gis bod mi tshor go skabs dang dka' ngal gnyis ka yong gi yod pa mthong gi 'dug /'on kyang kho rang gis dus rtag tu rang nyid ni bod kyi rig gzhung gi gong bu srung skyob dang sa mtha' lung khug gi mi tshor shes yon slob sbyong gi go skabs skrun mkhan gyi bod kyi mi riḍa ring luḍa pa zhig tu brtsi bzhin yod tshul sogs bshad 'dug /phyi lo 1998 lor e ri she dus babs kyi gsar 'god pa zhig gis bcar 'dri byas 'dug pa'i nang gtso bo bod kyi skad yig skor gleng 'dug /de yang khong gnyis kyis grangs mang mi rigs kyi khrod du grangs nyung mi rigs tshos rang gi skad yig sbyong spyod byed rgyur 'phrad pa'i dka' ngal gleng slong byas 'dug pa dper na/ bod nang bod rigs tshos gzhung la snyan zhu 'bul skabs bod yig nang bris tshe/ bod rigs drung yig kha shas kyis ma gtogs gnad yod las byed kyis do snang mi byed par brten/ tha na bkra shis tshe ring rang nyid kyis kyang gzhung la snyan zhu tshang ma rgya yig thog 'bri bzhin yod tshul dang / de bzhin bod rigs ched las pa tshos kyang rang gi las don nang bod yig spyad tshe mdun lam la do phog yong gi red snyam nas rgya yig spyod pa/ bod nang mtho rim gyi shes yon spyi dang lhag par tshan rig gi shes bya rnams rgya yig kho nar brten nas ma gtogs sbyong thabs med pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan la brten nas bod yig gnas babs ha cang dma' bo chags yod tshul gleng / gnas babs de 'drar gyur na yang bkra shis tshe ring gis nan tan ngang bod rigs gzhon skyes tshor na dang po bod kyi skad yig nges par du sbyong dgos/ gang yin zer na khyed rang bod rigs yin pa dang bod kyi skad yig 'di khyed rang gi pha ska da red/bod yig gis khyed rang gi mdun lam la ma phan na'ang nges par

300 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/du sbyong dgos/de ni khyed rang gi rig gzhung gi gal che'i cha shas shig red nyi ces brjod kyi yod ces bshad 'dug /phyi lo 2001 lor mi chi ghan gtsug lag slob khang nas yin pa'i ngo shes rnying pa zhig dang a ri'i gtsug lag slob khang kha shas nas yin pa'i nang pa'i slob phrug brgyad bkra shis tshe ring gi sar yong nas bcar 'dri byas 'dug cing / dri ba dang po der na khyed kyis rang nyid bod mi dmangs la lhag bsam rnam dag yin kyang tā la'i bla ma mchog la de ltar min tshul bshad 'dug pas/ de'i thad khyed la gsal kha byed rgyu ga re yod mi ces dris par/ dri ba des bkra shis tshe ring ton 'thor te skabs shig ring ga bshad 'di bshad med par gyur cing / 'dzam gling nang mi tshang mas ji ltar gus brtsi zhu ba bzhin bkra shis tshe ring gis kyang 7gong sa mchog la gus brtsi ha cang chen po zhu yi yod ces bshad 'dug /gong gi dri ba des bkra shis tshe ring gi sems la phog thug chen po byung bar brten/ slob phrug de dag song rjes khong gis 'phrin yig ring po zhig bris te/ de'i nang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po nas nang chos dar tshul dang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon sogs kyi skor gleng ste khong gi ngos nas bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gzhung rnams rtsa cher 'dzin gyi yod pa de mtshon par byas/lo de ga'i nang a ri nas bkra shis tshe ring la dmigs bsal che mthong gi lag 'khyer zhig gnang 'dug pa'i tshig brjod kyi cha shas su (('di ni sku zhabs bkra shis tshe ring lags phyi lo 2001 zla 5 tshes 16 nyin byams sems can gyi mngon med dpa' bo (7ba5009blo nga005) 50 khrod kyi gcig la 'dems thon byung ba'i lag 'khyer yin zhing / de ltar yin par 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma mchog sku dngos kyis ngos bzhes thob yod 〉〉ces 'khod 'dug /gzengs bstod lag 'khyer sprod pa'i mdzad sgo der bkra shis tshe ring ngo bcar ma thub kyang / khong gis mdzad sgo der 'phrin yig cig phul 'dug pa'i nang dzu phran gyi thog ma'i dad sems ni rang nyid kyis chung dus sbyangs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung la brten nas byung zhing / nga'i dmangs gtso'i yid ches ni a ri'i slob grwa'i nang nas sbyong skal byung ba'i nub phyogs kyi blo rgya yangs pa'i lta grub la brten nas byung / de bzhin nga'i rgyas spros med pa'i 'tsho ba'i lta ba ni/ bod mi'i bcos ma ma yin pa'i 'dod chung chog shes kyi gshis ka la brten nas byung ba zhig yin nyi zhes bris 'dug la/ gong gsal gyi gnad 'gag gsum de bkra shis tshe ring gis slob grwa 'dzugs pa sogs kyi las don gnyer ba'i bsam blo'i 'byung rtsa yin par bshad 'dug /

lhan thabs dang po/ 301yang rgya nag gzhung gis bkra shis tshe ring la dogs pa byas tshul yang gleng 'dug /de yang phyi lo 2001 lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i nang bod rang skyong ljongs slob gso las khungs kyis bkra shis tshe ring la 'phrin yig cig dang mnyam du 'gengs shog cig sprad cing / 'phrin yig nang bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i las 'khyur zin pa'i dge rgan bkra shis tshe ring gis da phan rnam gling rdzong khongs su mi dmangs shog sgor sa ya gnyis lhag btang ste slob grwa mang po btsugs shing / dngul de dag ni khong sger gyi tshong 'bab nas byung ba zhig red/ khong gi legs skyes de tshos ring min 'tshogs rgyu'i rgyal yongs slob gso'i tshogs chen gyi 'thus mir bcar chog pa'i cha rkyen tshang bar gyur yod/ gang yin zer na khong gi legs skyes de tshor brten nas mi dmangs khrod du bag chags ha cang chen po bzhag yod/ nye dus khong gis rnam gling du lag shes slob grwa zhig bskrun ched mi dmangs shog sgor sa ya gcig zhal 'debs su phul yod/ der brten ma gzhi khong rgas yol zhus zin pa'i spyi dmangs shig yin na yang / rgyal yongs slob gso'i tshoḍa chen du zhuḍa chog pa'i gros 'char 'don gyi yod sogs 'khod 'dug /'on kyang de rjes dang po tshogs 'du de dus 'gyangs byas pa dang / de nas bkra shis tshe ring gis bkang ba'i 'gengs shog la skyon zhig yod tshul go ba/ yang de rjes khong gi dzudzum dngul gyi 'byung rtsa gsal po mi 'dug 〉〉ces bshad par ma zad/ mtha' ma khong gi 'gengs shog de gsang ba'i spyi bde las khungs su zhib 'jug gi ched du btang 'dug /de ltar rnyog gra mang po bshad de mtha' ma bkra shis tshe ring gi tshab tu mi gzhan zhig rgyal yongs tshogs chen du btang /gnas tshul de ni chab srid kyi dogs gzhi'i 'og nas byung ba gsal po red/ de bzhin dus skabs gang tsam ring bkra shis tshe ring gi slob grwa'i skor bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par thog ched mngags 'god spel mi chog pa yang bzos 'dug /mtha' ma khong gi ngo shes bod rang skyong ljongs kyi las byed chos 'phel zhes pas slob gso las khungs la rtsod gleng chen po byas pa brgyud rgya nag gi slob gso'i blon chen las khungs nas bkra shis tshe ring la rmang gzhi'i slob gso'i thad legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgyal khab rim pa'i srol 'byed pa zhes pa'i gzengs bstod lag 'khyer sprad 'dug /de ltar khong gi mi tshe hril po'i ring phyogs mang po nas dogs pa dang rnam rtog byas stabs/ rang gis gang phan gang thub cig byed rgyu las gzhan dogs pa byed mkhan tshor khong gi ngos nas chod 'dzin thub thabs med ces gsungs shing / de ltar yang khong la skul lcag ha cang chen po thebs pa'i gnas tshul zhig byung 'dug pa de ni/ phyi lo 2002 zla 7 tshes 8

302 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/nyin 7gong sa mchog gi gcen po rgya lo don grub lags kyis zhal par gnang ste/ khong da lta lha sar slebs yod pas bod kyi gsol mgron khang nang bkra shis tshe ring dang thug 'dod yod ces gsungs pa de red/khong gnyis 1981 lor zhan yang dang / 1992 lor hong kong bcas dus thung ring thengs gnyis mjal myong 'dug kyang / skabs de dag tu bkra shis tshe ring la grub 'bras mngon che ba bstan rgyu med pa red/ bkra shis tshe ring bod kyi gsol mgron khang du 'gro skabs/ sngon ma rgya lo don grub lags dang a rir bka' mol byung ba rnams dran gso thebs te sems tshor nam rgyun dang ma 'dra ba byung 'dug /khong gnyis mnyam du zhogs ja mchod cing rgya lo don grub lags kyis thog mar khong phyi lo 1952 lor lha sar yong zhing / skabs de'i dmigs yul ni bka' shag la sa zhing bcos bsgyur byed dgos pa'i skul slong byed rgyu de yin/ 'on kyang bka' shag gis ma nyan pa'i thog /rgya mis khong la yar rgyas kyi bkag rdo gtsang sel byed rogs byed dgos zhus par brten/ bod mir rgyab gtod dang rgya mir rogs ram gnang 'dod med pa'i dbang nas bod nas gsang ba'i sgo nas phebs lugs gsungs/de nas khong gis phyi lo 1979 lor teng zha'o phing gis bod rgya'i 'brel ba yar rgyas su gtong ched khong gdan zhu gnang ba ltar/de nas bzung khong sku sger gyi ngos nas rgya nag gi 'go 'khrid cang tse min tshud pa'i dpon rigs thug par pe cing du dus nas dus su yong bar ma zad/ lha sar yang gnas tshul mkhyen rtogs ched dngos su phebs tshul gsungs shing /mjug tu khong gis 2 drang po bshad na/ sngon ma ngas khyed rang dmigs bsal gyis thug 'dod gang yang med/ yin na yang khyed rang gis las ka yag po byed kyi yod pa dang / so so'i dngul btang ste slob grwa mang po 'dzugs rogs byas yod pa go thos byung bas/ da res khyed rang thug 'dod byung / ngas da lta'ang yid ches byed pa'i don dag gcig ni/ nga tsho bod rigs tsho la ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong gi gnas babs dgos pa'i dgos 'dun 'don pa'i dbang cha yod pa de red/ 'on kyang nga rang rgya gar ba dang a ri ba tshos blo pham bcug byung / da ngas rgya rigs dang bod rigs gnyis kyis phan tshun so so'i thob thang la brtsi 'jog gis mnyam rub kyi thog nas las ka byed stangs shes pa byed dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin thob byung 〉〉zhes gsungs 'dug/bkra shis tshe ring gis phar ga re zhus yod med deb de'i nang bris mi 'dug na'ang / khong gi lo rgyus deb de rgya lo don grub lags su phul 'dug cing / khong gis de nges par du ljags klog

lhan thabs dang po/ 303gnang gi yin gsungs 'dug /bkra shis tshe ring la mtshon na/ rgya lo don grub lags kyis rang gi byas 'bras la ngos 'dzin dang che mthong gnang ba des sems 'gul chen po thebs 'dug/le'u drug pa/ 'byung 'gyur gyi skor/༄༅// le'u 'di'i nang bkra shis tshe ring gis 'byung 'gyur gyi re ba dang yid ches kyi skor bshad cing / de yang e ma sgang zhes pa'i sa char bod kyi lag shes slob grwa chen mo zhig 'dzugs rgyu dang / /sa khyon mu'u 318 yod 'dug mu'u 6 la e kur gcig red/) lag shes slob grwa de'i nang tha na deng rabs dang mthun pa'i zhing las byed stangs tshun nas slob 'char yod tshul bkod 'dug /las gzhi der khyen mi dmangs shog sgor 1800000 'gro rgyu dang /de'i ched rnam gling rdzong gis sgor 400000dang /gzhis ka rtse slob gso las khungs kyis sgor 400000gtong rgyu/bkra shis tshe ring gis sgor 1000000 gtong rgyu/ rnam gling rdzong gis slob grwa 'dzin skyong byed mkhan mi sna brgyad bsko rgyu dang / ar las 'dzugs skrun lo gsum nas lnga bar gyi dus yun nang tshar ba byed rgyu/ slob grwa de mtha' ma rang kha rang gso thub pa bzo rgyu sogs kyi 'char gzhir ming rtags bkod zin 'dug /slob ma ni bkra shis tshe ring gi slob grwa dang de min nye khor slob grwa'i 'dzin rim drug pa nas dgu pa bar gyi slob phrug bsdu rgyu/ slob tshan khongs deng rabs kyi so nam byed thabs dang /'phrul chas nyams gso dang bshig sgrig /phyugs zog gso tshags byed thabs/ 'tshem bzo/ khrom ra'i nang btsong rung ba'i thon rdzas bzo skrun bcas yod par ma zad/ ma 'ongs par nyams zhib dang glog klad/ yul de'i thon 'bab ltar zhog khog dang pad kha'i son thon skyed byed sa zhig kyang 'dzugs rgyu'i re ba yod 'dug /'char gzhi ltar na 2001 lo'i zla 10 par 'dzugs skrun gyi rim pa dang po'i khongs su 'dzin khang gi khang rtseg brgyad dang /nyal khang /spyi thab/khang rtseg gtso bo'i ra ba bcas tshar ba byed dgos kyang de ltar ma tshar ba'i dbang gis/ lo de'i phyi zla 11pa'i nang slob ma 20 yod pa'i 'tshem bzo'i 'dzin grwa ma gtogs tshugs ma thub/'dzugs skrun gyi rim pa gnyis pa 2002 lo'i zla 1 por 'go btsugs shing / de'i nang drod khang bskrun te sngo tshal 'debs 'go btsugs pa dang / kha par gyi skud pa dang ri

304 pha yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/steng dang rgyug chu nas chu 'khrid 'dzugs byas te zhing khar 'dren gtong byed pa/ rta shugs bco brgyad can gyi 'brud 'then 'khor lo gnyis nyos te sbyong brdar sprod 'go btsugs shing /2002 lo'i zla 9 par slob phrug 20 bsdus te 'phrul 'khor bshig sgrig gi sbyong brdar sprod 'go btsugs 'dug /khul der grog med stabs nyi 'od kyi nus pa dang snum spyod glog 'don 'phrul 'khor la brten dgos kyi yod par brten/ gzhung gis sa khul de tshor ring min glog 'khrid rgyu'i re ba byed bzhin yod 'dug /phyi lo 2003 lor 'dzugs skrun gyi rim pa gsum pa 'go btsugs shing / bkra shis tshe ring gis dngul bton te slob grwa der ba phyugs dang phag pa nyo 'dod par ma zad/ ar las lag rtsal dang / kha gdan 'thag las/ 'phrul las lag rtsal bcas kyi dge rgan btsal te 'dzin grwa gnyer 'dod yod lugs gsungs 'dug /gzhan yang khong gis bod phrug tshos slob sbyong la le lo byed pa dang pha ma tshos rang gi phru gur 'tsho ba skyid po zhig yong ched grong khyer las grong gseb tu gtong 'dod mi byed pa/ khrims kyi brgyud rim rnams rgya skad rgya yig spyad de lag bstar byas stabs bod mi tshos rgya nag gi khrims lugs la do snang mi byed pa sogs kyi thad rang gi myong tshor dngos la brten nas 'grel bshad gnang 'dug cing / de dag gi snying po ni/ slob sbyong hur thag mi byed mkhan de tshos ma 'ongs par rang gi las ka yang hur thag byed rgyu ma red ces dang / grong gseb la phyin na grong khyer nang nas shes mi thub pa'i gnas lugs dang nyams myong mang po thob rgyu yod pa/ rgya nag gi khrims lugs khag la do snang byas tshe/ bod mi spyi sger tshang mas so so'i khe dbang srung skyob thub rgyu yin lugs 'grel bshad byas 'dug /de bzhin da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs gcig gnyis ring gi pha ma tsho ni bod kyi lo rgyus nang gi gtso gnad gcig chags rgyu yin stabs/bod kyi skad yig rig gzhung la do snang gtsigs chen byed dgos pa nan bshad thog /da lta'i mi mang pos rlung 'phrin dang tshags par/ dpe deb khag la do snang mi byed par ma zad/ dka' ngal tshang ma zhabs rim dang ltag sgo brgyud de sel re byed pa dang / tshan rig dang lag rtsal la do snang mi byed par zhing la sad ser byung skabs dang /phyugs la god kha byung skabs lo stong phrag ring lag bstar byas pa'i srol rgyun gyi byed thabs rgyun 'dzin byed par skyon brjod kyis de tshor 'gyur ldog gtong dgos tshul gsungs 'dug /de bzhin khong gis bod nang brtson sems shin tu che ba'i gzhon skyes shes ldan mi sna khag cig yod kyang / de dag ni nyung shas yin pa dang / de tsho'i khongs zhing pa dang mi dmangs dkyus

lhan thabs dang po/ 305ma ha lam med tshul gsungs te/ yar rgyas kyi rtsa ba ni mi rang nyid yin pa las lam lugs min la/ yar rgyas kyi brgyud rim tshang ma 'og nas gong du 'gro dgos pa las/ gong nas 'og tu yong ba 'di yag po ma red/ 'on kyang bod nang brgyud rim de 'dra zhig ga dus yong gi red/dpe mtshon du smras na/ bkra shis tshe ring khong las go ma 'pher bar gyur skabs/ khong gi las mjug skyel mkhan su yong gi red ces gsungs 'dug /de'i dpe mtshon du khong gis dngos byung gnas tshul zhig bkod 'dug pa'i nang / khong rtag par dngul khang du 'gro skabs/ dngul khang gi las byed bsod nams bde skyid ces pa thog mar ngo shes tshul dang / bud med des bkra shis tshe ring gi las ka dang dmigs yul shes rjes rgyab skyor ched zla rer rang gi zla phogs nas mi dmangs shog sgor 100 re zhal 'debs su phul ba sogs bu mo de byams snying rje che ba dang rmang gzhi'i cha rkyen legs par brten/ rim pas bkra shis tshe ring gis bud med de rang gi rjes 'dzin par gso skyong byed 'dod byung ste phyi rgyal la slob sbyong du gtong gtan 'khel yang /bu mo de'i pha mas dogs pa rnam rtog dang bkag 'gog byas thog /mthar bsod nams bde skyid rang ngos nas kyang mi 'gro ba'i thag gcod byas tshul gyi brgyud rim ring po zhig bkod 'dug /yang de'i mjug tu rnam gling rdzong gi dpon rigs dpal rnam gyi skor yang bkod 'dug cing / de yang phyi lo 1960 lor dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur 'go 'dzugs byas ma thag dpal rnam gyi las dzi'i sde tshan sa skya rdzong gis khong hran shi zhing chen gyi zhan yang mi rigs slob chen du btang ba dang / der khong gis rgya yig dang chab srid/ ang rtsis/ dngul rtsis bcas sbyangs shing / lo de gar srid gzhung gis bod du slog nas gzhis rtse'i nye 'gram rgya shar la skad sgyur gyi las ka byed bcug /phyi lo 1965 lor khong gzhis rtse nas rnam gling la gnas spos byas par brten/ bkra shis tshe ring gi pha yul gur phyogs su chab srid kyi bsgyur bcos byed pa'i las 'gul dang 'brel yod du gyur/ skabs der gur phyogs kyi sa gnas 'go 'khrid pas bkra shis tshe ring gi pha ma dang nang mi rnams la gral rim dgra bo dang gsar brjer ngo log pa'i nyes zhwa g.yog zin pas/rgyu dngos yongs rdzogs gzhung bzhes kyis gnas stangs ha cang mtha' skyo'i 'og bzhag yod/dpal rnam slebs rjes kho pa'i sne 'khrid 'og bkra shis tshe ring gi pha ma dang nang mi tshor 'thab rtsod kyi tshogs 'du mang po bskongs te mnar gcod tshad med btang bar brten/ tshe gang ring lus po gcong can bzos pa red/ de bzhin bkra shis tshe ring gi bu spun kong po'i brtsan khang du btang ste ltogs shi thebs/ de nas dpal rnam yul rgya mtshor gnas spos btang ba dang / rgya

306 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/mtshor las ka hur thag byas te grub 'bras ha cang chen po byung bar brten/ phyi lo 1983 lor rnam gling rdzong gi tang gi drung cher gnas spar byas pa red/ sa mtha' lung khug dang dpal 'byor gnas stangs ha cang zhan pa'i grong gseb tu las ka lo mang byas par brten/ khong pas rim bzhin mi mang nyam thag gi dka' ngal shes rtogs byung nas dka' ngal de tsho sel thabs la 'bad brtson byed sems bcangs/ der brten khong gi dus yun ring mang tshogs kyi yong sgo 'phar thabs dang / gzhung lam bzo ba/ sman khang bskrun pa/ slob 'bring gsar 'dzugs/ zam chen 'dzugs pa sogs mang tshogs la phan pa'i las ka mang po byas/de bzhin bkra shis tshe ring gi khyim tshang dang dpal rnam dbar lo rabs drug cu pa'i nang gi 'khon 'gras chen po yod kyang / gnyis kus spyi don gyi ched du de dag rna rgyab kyi rlung bur brtsis te mnyam las byas par ma zad/ de sngon dpal rnam gyi rogs ram 'og bkra shis tshe ring gi pha ma dang spun nye tshor gsar brjer ngo log pa'i zhwa mo g.yog pa rnams srid gzhung la dkar 'don yong ba zhus te gtsang ma bzo thub 'dug /de bzhin dpal rnam gyis mi dmangs kyi don du gzab brling brtan gsum gyi sgo nas las ka byed stangs la bsngags brjod byas 'dug /phyi lo 1997 lo nas bkra shis tshe ring gis rang gi slob grwa nas thon te mu mthud slob rim gong ma 'grims 'dod yod pa'i slob phrug la skyed ka mi dgos pa'i bu lon g.yor ba'i las gzhi gsar pa zhig kyang 'go btsugs 'dug/las gzhi de'i khongs skabs der slob phrug17la glog klad dang 'phrod bsten slob gso/ ar las lag rtsal/ rtsis gnyer/ zhing las/ slob 'khrid/drod khang lag rtsal/ kha lo ba sogs slob sbyong gi go skabs bskrun 'dug /de bzhin lha sa'i nang bkra shis tshe ring gis khang rtseg cig nyos te/ khong gi slob grwa nas thon rjes lha sar slob gnyer byed mkhan tsho'i sdod gnas su bsgyur 'dug cing / khang rtseg de'i nang 'dzin khang dang nyal khang / glog klad sbyong brdar khang bcas yod la/ de'i 'dzin skyong slob phrug cig la byed bcug 'dug /deb de 'bri skabs kyi 'das lo'i dgun kha'i gung gseng skabs slob phrug 13 gyis khang rtseg de'i nang dbyin yig dang rgya yig /glog klad bcas kyi sbyong brdar byas pa dang / dbyin yig slob mkhan ni phyi rgyal ba red/ khang rtseg de'i nang sdod mkhan slob phrug cho'i sa nas zas dod sne sel re bsdu bzhin yod 'dug /bkra shis tshe ring gis 'dir bkol ba'i thabs shes shig ni/ slo ba phrug rgan gras tshos gzhon pa tshor slob 'khrid dang rogs ram byas te/ khang rtseg 'di sdod gnas tsam ma yin par phan tshun

lhan thabs dang po/ 307rogs ram gyis shes yon yar rgyas gtong sa zhig tu bsgyur ba de red/ de ltar yong thabs su khong gis slob 'khrid byed mkhan slob phrug la gla cha'i tshul du khong tsho'i bu lon nas rim pas gcog cha byed bzhin yod 'dug /de bzhin bkra shis tshe ring gi dmigs yul gal che gcig ni/ de ltar slob phrug la rogs ram byed pa dang mnyam du khong tshor 'gan khur du bcug nas rim pas/ khong gi phrag pa'i thog gi 'gan rnams mi rabs rjes mar rtsis sprod thub thabs byed rgyu de red/de min gyi thabs lam gcig ni/ slob grwa'i las gzhi rgyun gnas thub pa dang / slob phrug rtse phud rnams la mu mthud slob rim gong ma 'grims thub pa'i mthun rkyen bskrun ched ((bkra shis tshe ring gi thebs rtsa nyi zhes pa zhig 'dzugs rgyu de yin zhing / de'i ched du khong gis lha sa'i nang gi khrom sa legs shos kyi gras tshe smon gling sa khul nas thog rtseg bzhi can gyi khang rtseg cig nyos shing / khang pa'i rin gong ha cang mtho na yang gzhan nas dngul g.yar te nyes 'dug /khang pa de tsho'i lde mig 2002 zla 9 nang khong gi lag tu thob cing / de'i ched mi mang pos rogs ram byas 'dug /khong gi 'char gzhi ltar na/ khang pa de dag khang glar btang ste khe 'bab kyi thog nas khong gi slob grwa'i las gzhir gtan 'jags kyi gron dngul mkho sprod byed thub par ma zad/slob phrug rtse gras la slob yon sprod rgyu de red/mjug tu khong gis 'di ni ngas bod kyi ched du gtan 'jog byas pa'i ma rtsa legs shos de yin/ mi kha shas kyis khong gi 'char gzhi de tsho don dngos dang mi ma thun pa yin par bsams srid kyang khong gis tshe gang ring mi gzhan tshos de 'dra byed rgyu yod ma red ces sam/ de 'dra byed thub kyi ma red ces bshad pa'i las ka sha stag byas nas bskyal ba yin/ 1960 re grangs nang khong bod du log rtsis byed skabs a ri'i nang gi groḍa po tshos khong smyon pa red ces bshad pa dang /de bzhin khong gis slob grwa 'dzugs rtsis byed skabs mi brgya phrag mang pos de 'dra byed rgyu'i bsam blo gtong ba ni smyon pa red ces bshad myong ba tsam ma zad/mang po zhig gis de 'dra zhig bsgrub thub rgyu min shag shag byas/ 'on kyang bsgrubs thub pa red/ da lta nga tshos lo bcu'i gong du bsam yul la'ang 'char mi srid pa'i lag shes kyi slob grwa chen mo zhig la blta bzhin yod pas/ so sos rgyun mthud du 'bad brtson byas na bsgrubs mi thub pa med pa de hang sangs dgos pa zhig red ces gsungs 'dug/

308 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/mjug rtsom/༄༅// 'di'i nang bkra shis tshe ring gis slob grwar rogs skyor byed mkhan phyi rgyal ba khag cig khrid de 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin pa'i e ma sgang gi lag shes slob gyur bskyod pa dang /de tsho'i khrod kyi nyi hong gi grwa pa khag cig gis zhal 'debs a sgor khri gcig gnang ba/ nyin gang brel zing gi khrod nas dgong mo nyal rjes nam phyed du bkra shis tshe ring gnyid las sad de/ rang nyid chung dus yi ge sbyangs tshul dang / thog ma'i 'phrin yig de lha sa nas rang gi sgyu mar btang tshul/ de la lan 'byor tshul/ rgya gar nas dbyin yig sbyangs tshul sogs yi ge shes pa'i phan nus dran gso byas shing / bkra shis tshe ring gi a mas khong sems bag srab cing ngang rgyud ring la skad cha shod rgyur dga' ba'i thog /rang gi gcen po nang bzhin sgam nan med pas dgra la kha gtad dang grogs dang zhi 'grig thub kyi ma red snyam pa'i sems ngal 'dug ces gsungs pa dang / khong gi phas 88bkra shis tshe ring ni mi blo khog dang drang tshugs che la/ blo thag chod po zhig chags kyi red/ khos phan thogs byed 'dod na phan pa chen po byed mkhan zhig dang / gnod skyel 'dod na gnod pa chen po skyel mkhan zhig chags kyi red nyi ces gsungs tshul drangs te/ a mas gdeng 'jog gnang ba de nor ba dang phas gdeng 'jog gnang ba ltar gyi mi zhig yin tshul brjod 'dug /mjug rtsom 'di 'bri stangs kyi cha nas klog pa por bag chags chen po 'jog thub pa zhig las/ nang don gyi cha nas gnas tshul gsar pa de tsam yod pa zhig ma red/wi liyam ar sa'i bhan shu yi mjug gtam/༅༅// le tshan 'di'i nang rtsom pa po rang nyid bkra shis tshe ring dang mnyam du gur phyogs dang padma thang gi slob grwa sogs su bskyod skabs kyi bod kyi zhing pa'i 'tsho gos gnas stangs skyo bo dang / zhing las byed thabs rjes lus yin pa sogs kyi mthong tshul dang / lam bar bkra shis tshe ring dang gleng mol byung ba khag /bkra shis tshe ring gis mi mang dkyus ma dang las don khrod kyi dka' ngal chung tsag la do snang byed stangs rnams bris 'dug /mjug tu bkra shis tshe ring dang rtsom pa po gnyis gangs ljongs mgron khang du zhogs zas la rol ba dang / der bkra shis tshe ring gis rang nyid la rgya nag gzhung gis dogs pa byas te

lhan thabs dang po/ 309yang bskyar blta zhib byed 'go btsugs zin pa/ de sngon bkra shis tshe ring gi lo rgyus deb dang po de a ri nas sbrags thog brgyud de 'byor skabs/ rgya gzhung gi las byed pas kha phye ste deb gcig gzhung bzhes byas pa/ de min gyi gnas tshul yang yod pa bcas kyi skor bshad cing /mtha' ma rang nyid de sngon btson khang du thengs gcig 'gro myong ba ltar rgya gzhung gis ga re byed thub min shes kyi yod/ 'on kyang ngas de tshor snang ba gtod kyi med/ gnas tshul ga re byung na'ang khong gi slob grwa dang 'brel ba'i deb 'di 'don thub pa byed rgyu yin lugs gsungs 'dug pa bcas so//gong gsal rnams ni las brel shin tu che ba'i bar gseng du dbyin yig nas snying bsdus su bkod pa yin pas/ gal che'i gnas tshul mang po 'dir bsdu ma thub pa dang / bsdus pa rnams rdog la sgril ma thub pa'i skyon cha yod nges na/ zhib par mkhyen 'dod pa tshos ma dpe dbyin deb rang la gzigs par zhu'o////

lhan thabs gnyis pa/sku zhabs bkra shis tshe ring gis phyi lo 1986 lo'i zla ba 2 tshes 20 nyin 'brel yod rgya nag gzhung la phul ba'i snyan zhu/harsha70༄༅//mdza' brtse ldan pa'i blo mthun mchog la/nga'i ming la bkra shis tshe ring zer zhing / bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i dbyin ji'i skad yig gi dge rgan zhig yin/ ngas gsham du slob gso'i skor gyi gnad don 'ga' zhig zhus chog pa/slob gso dang las ku'i go skabs skor/༄༅//1979lor bod ljongs yongs nas mes rgyal slob grwa che khag dang /ljongs sa khul gyi slob grwa che khag la slob phrug khyon bsdoms 800 btang yod pa'i nang bod rigs slob phrug naX las med/ 1984 lor bod kyi slob grwa che khag gsum gyi slob phrug bsdoms grangs 1984 yod pa'i nang rgya rigs slob ma 131na zin yod kyang bod rigs slob ma 666 las med/ lo de ga'i nang bod nas mes rgyal slob grwa che khag la slob phrug 250 btang yod rung bod rigs slob phrug60 nas 70 bar las med/ gong gsal gyi bsdoms rtsis khag nas ra sprod byung ba ltar na/ bod kyi slob gso'i thog gi 'gro song shugs che ba ni rgya rigs slob phrug thog la bed spyod gtong gi yod/ gnas tshul de rigs ni slob grwa che khag nang de bas kyang de 'dra red/ 'di'i thog nas bod rigs la slob gso'i thad don dngos kyi 'dra mnyam med pa gsal por mtshon thub/gnas

312 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/tshul de rigs lhags dgos don ci yin zhe na/ lan 'debs rgyu ni ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba zhig yin na yang /rang nyid kyi lta tshul zhu yi yin/lo rgyus thog bod ni kher rkyang du gnas shing rjes lus thebs pa'i sa khul yin par ma zad/ rig gnas slob gso yang ha cang rjes lus thebs pa zhig red/ bcings bkrol thob rjes slob gso'i bya gzhag gong 'phel chen po byung yod mod/ 'on kyang nga tshor da dung yang yig rmongs brgya cha 70 yod pa'i gnas tshul mu mthud nas bsdad yod cing / lhag par du rig gnas gsar brje chen pos nga tsho ni de bas kyang rjes lus kyi gnas su lus pa zhig bzos byung / deng gi char bod kyi don dngos kyi gnas tshul dang 'tshams pa dang / bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas chu tshad mtho ru gtong rgyu'i dgos mkhor bstun pa'i slob gso'i lam lugs shig med khar/ bod rigs tshor 'dra mnyam gyi slob gso thob pa byed rgyu'i dbang char 'gan srung byed pa'i khrims lugs shig kyang med/ de'i thog la bod du yod pa'i rgya rigs blo mthun rnams dang / las don mi sna tshos so so'i bu phrug tshor slob gso legs tsam zhig thob na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dun pa shin tu drag po zhig bcangs dang 'chang bzhin yod/ blo pham pa zhig la/ kho tsho'i bu phrug gi slob sbyong thad kyi khe phan 'di ni bod ljongs sa gnas mang tshogs kyi khe phan dang thad kur 'gal zlar langs yod pas ma tshad/ srid byus yang dag pa lag len bstar rgyu'i thad la'ang bkag 'gog chen po byed kyi 'dug slob gso dang las ga'i go skabs gnyis kyi 'brel ba ni dam zab yod pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar la bskyar du bshad ci dgos/der brten kho pa chos deng dus kyi slob gso'i lam lugs la bcos sgrig byed rgyur 'dod pa rtsa ba nas byed kyi med/ don dngos thog nga tsho'i deng dus kyi slob gso'i lam lugs 'dir 'gyur ldog shugs chen zhig dgos nges yin par brten/ khyed kyis zhib tshags dang nan tan ngang / gsham gsal gyi gnas tshul dang 'brel yod gnad don la rtog zhib gnang rogs zhu rgyu nga'i re 'dun yin/ngas bltas na/ slob gso dang las ku'i go skabs gnyis kyi skor ni bod rigs phal ba rnams kyi ngos nas bshad na tshor snang drag po skye dgos pa dang / sems 'khur chen po byed dgos pa'i gnad don gnyis red/ gang lags she na/ don chen de gnyis ni don dag gang las kyang gal che zhing / de dag ni bod mi rigs yongs dang sger so so'i khe phan dang thad kur 'brel ba yod pa yin/ lhag par du kho tsho'i bu phrug tsho'i mdun lam gyi don chen dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa red/ de ltar yin pa'i rkyen gyis bod rigs mi grangs mang che bas spyi tshogs kyi drang bden min

lhan thabs gnyis pa/ 313pa'i snang tshul de rigs la 'e 'khon byed kyi yod pa'i 'khang ra rtag tu thos rgyu yod/ gnas tshul 'di'i rigs dper na rgya gar shar phyogs a sam rigs dang / nub bhang ga la'i rigs gnyis dbar gyi 'thab rtsod ltar/ rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi khe phan 'gal zlar langs pa'i gnas tshul dza drag rno ngar can du ma gyur gong gus bkur 'os pa'i dbu 'khrid rnam pas bod ljongs kyi slob gso'i lam lu gas thos gi gnad donade bden drang 'dra mnyam gyi lam du khrid nas mgyogs myur ngang thag gcod yong ba zhu rgyu dang 'brel/ rang rgyal mi rigs khag gi mthun sgril chen po'i khe phan gyi slad du gsham gsal gyi don tshan gsum don thog tu 'khyol ba'i re ba zhu rgyu yin/1 nga tshos da yod kyi slob gso'i lam lugs la rtsa ba'i bsgyur bcos byed dgos pa dang /khrims lusas kyi thog nas nga tsho'i slob gso'i 'dra mnyam dbang char 'gan srung byed dgos/2 slob grwa che ba'i slob phrug grangs 'bor nyung 'phri byed rgyu dang / slob grwa 'bring chung gi slob gso'i gron dngul mang du gtong rgyu/3 bod kyi slob gso 'i 'gro gron gyi thog nas rang rer lugs dang mthun pa'i gron dngul gyi thob cha 'dra mnyam bgo 'grems yod par 'tshal/lha sa slob 'bring dang po/༄7// slob grwa der 'dzin grwa 28 yod pa'i nang bod rigs 'dzin grwa 12 dang / rgya rigs 'dzin grwa 18 'dug slob phrug bsdoms grangs 1451 nang rgya ma bod the bas bod rigs 938 yod pa dang / rgya rigs 518 yod pa des slob grwa de'i slob phrug bsdoms 'bor gyi brgya cha 37 za zin/rgya rigs slob phrug gis bod yig slob sbyong mi byed par ma zad/ rgya rigs 'dzin grwar 'gro mkhan bod rigs 387 gyis kyang bod yig slob sbyong byed kyi med tsang / slob grwa der bod yig slob sbyong byed mkhan bod rigs 546 las med/ slob grwa 'di'i nang khyen bsdoms dge rgan 111 yod pa'i nang bod rigs dge rgan 30tsam yod3 yang /bod yig slob mkhan 7las med/go thos la/ dge rgan gnas tshad yag shos kyis rgya rigs 'dzin grwar slob 'khrid byed pa dang / dge rgan gyi gnas tshad ma lon pas bod rigs 'dzin grwar slob 'khrid byed kyi yod ces pa'i shod srol 'dug ngas bltas na/skad cha de tshang ma bden pa yin min ji ltar yang /de'i nang skad cha bden

314 pha yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/pa 'ga' shas yod nges red snyam gyi 'dug /tha na las khungs 'ga' res las mi gsar pa bsdu skabs kyi yig tshad nang du'ang bod yig rtsa ba nas med/ slob grwa 'bring ba'i nang du/ sa gnas 'di ga'i slob phrug gis skad yig gi 'gag sgo sgrol ma thub par brten kho tshos slob tshan dngos khams rig pa dang / rdzas 'gyur rig pa sogs slob sbyong byed skabs dka' ngal dpag med 'phrad kyi yod/ spyi tshogs thog slob gso'i cha rkyen zhan po 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul 'og bod rigs slob phrug tshos bod yig slob 'dod rtsa ba nas byed kyi med/ 'di ni ngas rang re'i spyi tshogs nang rgyun srol las ldog pa'i mngon tshul ya mtshan can zhis/ yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ nga tshos byas na/ rang re'i bod rigs slob phrug tshos ma 'grig pa red ces khong tshor ya/ la 'gel 'os pa 3ga red dam zhe na dogs pa mi dgos pa zhig la/ nga tsho'i da yod kyi slob gso'i lam lugs dang /rgyal khab kyi las bzo 'dems bsgo'i lam lugs de dag ni rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs kyis skyon brjod byed dgos pa zhig los yin/nga tsho'i mi rabs rjes ma'i khe phan gyi ched dang /nga tsho'i thun mong gi rig gzhung snying bcud bod kyi skad yig mi nyams gong 'phel yong ched ngas sems thag gtsang bcad kyis re ba zhu rgyur/ 'dir bton pa'i gnad don khag thag gcod mgyogs myur yong ba'i thabs lam zhig ci nas kyang gtod par 'tshal/slob phrug bsdur tshad do mi snyom pa/༄༅// bod rigs slob ma slob chung dang / dma' rim slob 'bring mtho rim slob 'bring bcas dbar du slebs skabs kyi slob phrug bsdur tshad do mi snyom pa des bod rigs slob phrug mang po zhig slob grwa chen mor 'gro thub kyi med/ gnas tshul de rigs kyi 'og da dung mi 'ga' res slob phrug bsdu ba'i nus pa ha cang zhan zhing / bod rigs mtho rim slob 'bring gi slob phrug rnyed kyi mi 'dug ces shod pa rtag par go rgyu yod/ phyi tshul thog nas bltas na skad cha de bden mdog kha po yod kyang / skad cha 'di'i rgyab tu go rgyu'i nang don ci 'dra yod ce na/ de ni tshang mas shes gsal red/ de ltar slob phrug bsdu ba'i nus pa nyag phrar thug dgos don gang yin zhes mi 'ga' res 'dri srid/ de sus bzos pa red dam zhe na/ de ni dbang cha 'dzin mkhan tshos so so'i sger gyi khe phan la dmigs nas bzos pa'i bzo 'dra zhig rang gi lta snang du 'char/de ltar bzos pa'i nang don gang dang gang yod zer na gsham gsal te/

lhan thabs gnyis pa 3151 rgya rigs slob phrug mang po zhig gis mes rgyal nang khul du slob grwa chung 'bring 'grems rjes yi ga tshad lon ma thub pa'i gras bod du log nas yig tshad gtong chog gi yod/2 yig tshad kyi nang don gang 'dra zhig yin rung bod yig gi thog nas gtong dgos kyi med/de ni bod rigs slob phrug gis rgya yig chu tshad lon thub kyi med pa'i go skabs 'di bed spyod btang ba min na gang yin/3 bod kyi slob grwa 'bring chung gi slob gso'i cha rkyen shin tu zhan po yod/ zhing 'bros khul la ni de bas kyang bshad ci dgos/ kho tshor gcig nas dge rgan chu tshad mtho ba yag po dkon po yod pa dang / gnyis nas 'os 'tshams kyi slob khang med la slo ba deb yag po yang med/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni bod kyi rmang gzhi'i slob gso'i thog la gron dngul gtong rgyu nyung thag chod pa des byas pa red/4 bod rigs slob phrug gis bod yig dang rgya yig gnyis ka yig tshad gtong dgos pa dang /kho tsho'i sa bcad khag ni rgya yig gi thog nas slob dgos/ der brten kho tsho'i slob sbyong thad rim pa ga tshod kyis mtho na de tsam gyis kho tshor dka' ngal che ba yod/slob gso'i lam/ lugs 'di 'dra bzos pa'i gnas tshul 'di lta bu'i 'og tu bod rigs slob phrug gis gang 'dra byas te rgya rigs slob phrug tshor 'gran bsdur byed thub/ gal srid mi 'ga' res ched du mngags nas 'gog rkyen bzos pa zhig min pa'i dbang du btang yang 'di tsho tshang ma ni bod kyi deng rabs can gyi slob gso 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i 'gro lam thog gi don dngos kyi bkag rdo sha stag red/ slob grwa chung ba nas 'bring ba dang mtho ba'i bar bod rigs slob phrug gis mu mthud nas slob sbyong byed mi thub par slob grwa 'grims pa'i brgyud rim nang re re byas nas slob grwa dang kha gyes te phyir mi thon ka med yong gi 'dugade ltar byas pa'i 'bras bur/ slob grwa che bar 'gro mkhan gyi bod rigs slob phrug grangs 'bor ha cang ya nga dgos pa'i shin tu nyung nyung las med/ 'u thug nas slob grwa bzhag ste 'gro mkhan gyi slob phrug tsho'i bsam blor rgyu rkyen gnyis kyis shugs rkyen thebs pa dper na/ kho tsho'i bas ma par yig tshad gtong skabs rgya rigs slob phrug la kha gtad gcog mi thub snyam gyi yod/gal/ srid 'gran zla gcog thub dbang la cha bzhag na yang / khong tshor las ka yag po zhig rag e yong snyam pa'i the tshom skye yi yod/ 'o na de yang byung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ slob phrug bsdu ba nas yig tshad gtong ba/ las ka sprod pa sogs mig snga'i slob gso'i

316 pha yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/bkod sgrig byed stangs 'di rigs ni bod rigs slob phrug gi le phan las rgya rigs slob phrug gi khe phan la phan thogs de bas che ba yod pas yin / don dngos 'di ni slob grwa che ba'i nang de bas kyang de 'dra rang red/ deng gi dus su/ slob gso mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis mi zhig gi tshe gang gi las ka thag gcod byed pa ltar/ mi gcig gi mi tshe hril po de yang las rigs mi 'dra bas thag gcod byed kyi yod/ de ltar yin pa'i rkyen gyis de tsho'i skor la bsam blo mi gtong mkhan phar zhog bsam blo 'khor mkhan zhig yin phyin chad/ de ltar sems 'khur byed pa ni rang bzhin yin pa las/ mi gzhan gyi skul 'ded 'og bcos mar byas pa ci la srid/ yin na yang ngas nges par du ngos len byed dgos pa zhig la/bod rigs nang da lta yang yig rmongs brgya cha 70yod pas/rang nyid rmongs pa'i rkyen gyis gang 'dra byas te slob gso dang las ka bkod sgrig byed stangs thog gnas yod pa'i rang gi khe phan 'di bton nas re ba zhu thub kyi med/ de dang bsdur na/ shes bya yon tan yod pa'i bod rigs dpon rigs nyung shas dang / las byed pa nyung shas gcig gis gnad 'gag de gsal por shes kyi yod na yang / mi shes pa dang ma go ba'i tshul byas te skad cha mang po shod 'dod mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ha lam kho tsho'i bu phrug yongs rdzogs rgya rigs 'dzin grwa'i nang gtong gi yod pa dang / de nas kho tshor khe phan theb rgyu yod pa des 'dod blo tshim pa yin shag red/mtha' mjug tu rang nyid la mjug bsdoms 'di 'dra zhig thob byung / bod kyi slob gso'i lam lugs la bsgyur bcos mthar phyin pa zhig ma byung phyin/ nga tsho'i mi rabs rjes mar re ba gang yang thob rgyu med/ des na sngar bas mang ba'i dngos shugs dang / mi shugs rang re'i ljongs kyi rmang gzhi'i slob gso'i thog tu gtong gnang yod pa zhes re 'bod mtha' gcig tu zhu rgyu ni rang cag rnams kyis gces su 'os pa'i tang la ngas bcol ba'i re ba che shos de yin/rang ljongs sa khul 'dir bod kyi skad yig ni gtso bor 'dzin dgos/༅༅// dmangs spyod las khungs te/ dper na yig zam dang / dngul khang sogs kyi nang du bod yig bed spyod byed kyi med la brnyan 'phrin las khungs nang du yang bod yig bed spyod byed pa ha cang nyung nyung red/ tha na las khungs 'di tsho'i nang gi bod rigs las rigs mi sna mang che bas bod yig 'bri shes kyi med/ de'i 'bras bur yul mi rnams kyis las khungs de tsho'i nang

lhan thabs gnyis pa/ 317las don gcod du 'gro skabs phyi rgyal du slebs pa lta ra dka' ngal bsam brjod las 'das pa zhig yong sga 'dug skad yig thog na 'bos rkyen gyi rkyen pas bod rigs mang pos dngul dmar nang du nyar ba las dngul khang du bcol 'dod byed kyi med/ khong tsho dngul khang dang /yig zam khang du las don gcod par 'gro ska bas rgya yi ga 'bri mkhan zhig gla dgos pa ltar/glog brnyan dang brlan 'phrin blta bar 'gro skabs su yang skad sgyur zhig gla dgos kyi 'dugagayon thal can gyi sgrod byus kyi shugs rkyen rtsa zab sdo nga brtan du gnas pa'i 'og /tha na bod rigs las byed pa 'ga' zhig gis rang gi pha yul gcirge pa'i mang tshogs la gtam bshad spel skabs su'ang skad sgyur dgos kyi yong/ khong tsho'i bsam par rgya skad ni gzhung phyogs kyi dpon skad yin pas de spyad nas gtam bshad byas na dpon nyams dod po yong rgyu dang / nyan mkhan mang tshogs kyi sems la'ang khong tsho ni gang min tshad cig red snyam pa'i 'char tshul skye ru 'jug sems las gzhan ci/ srid byus gzhir bzung nas bshad na/ yang snying khong tsho'i byed stangs de rigs ni mi 'grig pa yin min gzu ldan skye bo rnams la dogs 'dri zhu rgyu yin/de yang ya mtshan skye rgyu ci la yod/ de ni deng skabs bod kyi spyi tshogs nang bod yig de nyid kyi go gnas de tshad gzhi gang 'dra zhig gi thog tu bzhag gi yod med kyi gnad don dang 'brel ba dam zab yod/ mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ dmangs spyod las khungs khag gi nang bod yig bed spyod gtong dgos pa'i skor gyi zhib phra'i khrims lugs shig med du mi rung bas de ltar gtan 'bebs byed dgos par ma zad/ so so'i lto phor 'dzugs sa 'tshol mkhan rnams kyi las kwa'i go skabs dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa zhig kyang bzo dgos/ zhar byung du smos rgyur/nye char bod du phebs ma thag pa'i dbu 'khrid gsar pa blo mthun wu'u cing ha yi gsung bshad nyan pa dang / khong gis bod ljongs su gang ci'i thad la rang skyong ming dang don mthun pa zhig yong ched/ khrims lugs gsar pa 'dzugs rgyu'i skor la gal che'i rang bzhin gyi nan bshad gnang bar rang nyid kyis do snang chen po byas par ma zad/ snying stobs 'phel ba'i sku la ma yang chen po thebs byung / rjes su bsam blo 'khor don/ khong gis thugs thag chod po'i sgo nas khong rang gsham 'og gi dpon rigs (rgya rigs yin na'i 'dra bod rigs yin na'i 'dra go gnas mtho ba )'bor chen zhig gi las gnas 'pho 'gyur byed thabs lag len ma bstar tshe/ kho rang gi ring lugs yag po ga tshad yod na'ang de dag lag len du 'khyol ba byed rgyur kho tshos bkag 'gog byed srid/ gang lags she na/ khong tsho ni da bar so so'i rang snang la shugs chen gyis brten nas gangs ljongs sa khul 'di skyong ba'i goms gshis zab mo zhig chags yod pa red/ ma 'ongs

318 pha yul gye phan bde'i ched du/par mgyogs myur 'tshogs rgyu yin pa'i tang gi rgyal yongs 'thus mi tshogs chen thog rang re'i rgyal khab kyi dpon rigs bsko bzhag dang / las byed 'angems sgrug byed pa'i lam lu gas der bsgyur bcos mthar phyin dza drag cig gnang yong bsam pa'i re sgug byed rgyu yin/lha sa slob chung dang po/༄༅// slob grwa 'di'i 'dzin grwa 43 yod pa'i nang bod rigs 'dzin grwa 17 dang rgya risas 'dzin grwa 17yod cing /slob phrug gi grangs 'bor 1900yod pa mas 1000bod rigs yin pa dang / 900 rgya rigs red/ bod rigs slob phrug daX tham pa rgya rigs 'dzin grwar 'gro gi yod cing khong tshos bod yig slob sbyong byed kyi med/ slob grwa 'di'i dge rgan 126 yod pa'i nang bod rigs dge rgan 78 yod pa dang / de'i nang bod yig dge rgan 18 tshud yod/ de 'phros rgya rigs dge rgan 48 'dug /slob grwa gzhan dang 'dra bar slob grwa 'dir yang dngul gyis ma ldang ba dang / dge rgan dkon pa/ slob deb dang slob khang med pa sogs kyi dka' ngal 'dra min 'phrad dang 'phrad bzhin 'dug /zhing 'brog khul thon skyed 'gan gtsang lam lugs lag len bstar rjes dmangs btsugs slob grwa 'ga' shas 'thor ba dang / slob grwa 'ga' zhig la dge rgan yod kyang slob phrug med pas kho tsho'i grangs 'bor nyung du phyin pa'i gnas tshul thon pa de rigs ni yig rmongs gsar pa mang du phyin pa'i rtags mtshan zhig yin shas che/'dir rgyu mtshan gnyis yod pa gsham gsal/1 slob phrug slob grwa nas 'then te khyim tshang gi thon skyed stobs shugs nang zhugs pa dang /da dge rgan gyi gla thob dma' bas mu mthud slob grwar las ka byed 'dod byed kyi med/krung u tshang 'dzoms thengs gsum pa 'tshogs pa nas bzung / spyi tshogs deng rabs can la 'gyur ba dang / mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba legs bcos yong rgyur grub 'bras chen po thob yod na'ang / zhing 'brog khul gyi slob gso'i thog ngas gong du zhus pa ltar 'gal ba gsar pa zhig thon yod/ngas bltas na/spyi tshogs gsar pa zhig bskrun par dper na 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs 4 lta bur cha bzhag /de ni tshang mas mthong ba dang kun gyis shes pa zhig red/ bod du byas pa'i lo gnyis kyi 'dzugs skrun de rigs ni lo rabs lnga bcu pa tshun nas byas pa'i 'dzugs skrun yongs rdzogs kyi lo rgyus las brgal ba'i bzo 'dra zhig mthong snang du mchis/ 'di ni krung

lhan thabs gnyis pa/ 319dbyang srid gzhung gis thugs thag chod po'i sgo nas gtan 'beb byas pa'i srid byus kyi thad kwa'i 'bras bu zhig los yin/ 'on kyang slob gso'i thog de dang 'dra ba'i thugs thag chod po'i srid byus shig gtan 'beb ma gnang tshe bod kyi deng rabs can gyi slob gso'i bya gzhag gong du 'phel ma thub par rang gnas su sdod rgyu nyag cig red/ 'das pa'i lo 35 ring la nga tshos slob gso'i thog gi thag gcod byas pa'i chod yig khag la de ring phyir bltas shig lta skabs/ nga tsho'i bsam pa de dag yongs su 'thus sgo tshang ba zhig red snyam gyi med/ de lta bu'i rgyu mtshan gzhir bzung nas bshad na/ nga tsho'i krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod kyi ma 'ongs pa'i slob gso'i bya gzhag thad thugs thag chod po'i thag gcod cig ma gnang na/ 'das lo 2000 la slebs dus rang re'i mi rabs rjes mas nga tshor yid mi rangs pa'i skyon brjod nan po byed srid/ der brten ngas re bas yongs su khengs pa'i sgo nas krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod kyi 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs 43 gyi thad la thugs thag chod po'i srid byus gtan 'bebs gnang ba de lta bu'i srid byus thugs thag chod po zhig bod kyi ma 'ongs pa'i slob gso'i bya gzhag thad la'ang gtan 'bebs gnang rogs zhes gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs rgyu yin/de ltar gnang ba yin na/ gzhi nas bod kyi deng rabs slob gsor re ba yod pa zhig mthong thub/bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i da yod bod rgya'i slob phrug gi bsdur tshad/༄༅// brtag dpyad byas par gzhigs na/ bod ljongs slob grwa chen mor da yod slob phrug khyon bsdoms mi grangs 671 'dug (slob phrug za khang gi 'tsho ba'i do dam pas bshad par gzhigs na/ slob phrug 629 las mi 'dug) 'on kyang 'dir slob phrug 671 yod par cha bzhag pa yin/ bod yig tshan khag dang bod sman gso rig tshan khag gnyis the bas tshan pa khag gi nang bod rigs slob phrug khyon bsdoms 413 yod pa des slob phrug yongs rdzogs kyi brgya cha 61 5 zin cing / rgya rigs slob phrug 258 yod pa des slob phrug yongs rdzogs kyi brgya cha 38 4 zin gyi 'dug /gnas tshul 'di'i thog nas bshad na/ slob phrug mang che ba ni bod rigs yin pa bshad ci dgos/ 'on kyang cung zhib phra'i sgo nas bshad na/ gnad don 'di 'dra zhig lhag yod pa gsham gsal/

320 pha yul sgru phan bde'i ched du/bod yig tshan khrag gi slob phrug 251dang /bod sman gso rig tshan khag gi slob phrug27phar phud nas bsdur tshad byed skyo ra zhig byas na/ tshan pa gzhan dag nang gi bod rigs slob phrug135las med pa des slob phrug yongs rdzogs kyi brgya cha 24 zhalas zin gyi med/de las ldog ste rgya rigs slob phrug 258 yod pa des slob phrug yongs rdzogs kyi brgya cha 65 na zin gyi 'dug /byas tsang slob grwa 'di'i nang da yod bod rgya'i slob phrug mang nyung gi bsdur tshad ni don dngos thog 'di rang yin/da dung gsal po zhus na/bod yig tshan khag dang /bod sman gso rig tshan khag gnyis nang ched gnyer gyi rkyen pas rgya rigs slob phrug zhugs thabs rtsa ba nas med/ gal srid tshan pa 'di gnyis nang rgya rigs slob phrug zhugs thabs yod tshe/ tshan pa gzhan dag nang gi bod rgya'i slob phrug bsdur tshad dang 'dra bar bod rigs nyung ba dang / rgya rigs mang ba yong rgyu lhag cig red/mi rnams kyis bod yig tshan khag la srid byus tshan khag ces ming 'dogs brgyab yod/de ni slob phrug bsdu skabs gong nas gtan 'bebs byas pa'i bod rigs brgya cha 60 dang /rgya rigs brgya cha 40 zer ba'i bod rgya'i slob phrug bsdur tshad kyi khyab khongs nang rgya rigs mang tsam bsdu 'jug dgos dbang gis bod rigs mang tsam bsdus te bod yig tshan khrag tu bzhag pa der zer/de ltar mu mthud byas tshe lo bcu'i nang bod yig ched gnyer slob phrug brgya phrag kha shas thon rung rtsis rig sogs tshan rig ched gnyer slob phrug mdzub mor grangs ka thebs pa lta bu'i grangs 'bor nyung ngu las thon gyi med/ tshabs chen gyi phyogs lhung de sngon 'gog byed dgos na bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang bstun nas slob grwa chen mo'i slob phrug gi grangs 'bor mang du gtong rgyu dang 'brel lo bco lnga'i ring bod kyi slob gso'i gtso gnad yongs rdzogs rmang gzhi'i slob gso'i thog tu 'jog dgos/dbyin ji'i skad yig 'dzin grwa'i skor/༄༅// 'dzin grwa 'di ni snga lo ston dus su bsdus shing / slob phrug khyon bsdoms 16 yod/bod rigs gnyis dang / rgya ma bod gnyis phar phud pas de 'phros slob phrug 12 ni rgya rigs sha stag red/

lhan thabs gnyis pa/ 321kho tshor zhib 'jug slob ma'i cha rkyen yod pa lta bu de ni a ri'i dge rgan zhig dang / pe cing phyi rgyal skad yig slob grwa'i dge rgan zhig ched mngags gdan drangs pa de thog nas mtshon thub/ de bzhin rang re'i slob dge zhig gis kyang slob 'khrid byed cing / rang nyid nas kyang zur 'khrid byed kyi yod/a ri'i dge rgan der cha bzhag na/ zla re'i phogs thob sgor 700 re dang lo re'i gung gseng 'gro gron sgor 800 re/ zla re bzhin lam kha'i 'gro song bcas sprod dgos par ma zad/sdod khang yang gra sgrig byed dgos/ pe cing nas gdan 'dren zhus pa'i dge rgan la zla re'i phogs thob sprod dgos smos med thog /gnam gru'i gla cha yang sprod dgos/des na 'dzin grwa 'di'i 'gro song ha cang chen po yin pa dpal 'byor gyi klad rtsa yod mkhan tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar red/'o na khe phan che shos thob mkhan su yin zhe na/de yang kun gyi mkhyen chod du de bas mi gsal lam ci/ 'di thog nas bod kyi mtho rim slob gso'i 'gro gron mang che ba ni rgya rigs slob phrug thog gtong gi yod pa slar yang gsal bshad thengs gcig byas/bla na med pa'i gus 'dud dang bcas/ bkra this tshe ring pas/ spyi lo 1986 lo'i zla ba 2tshes 20nyin/ja1rwa5///

lhan thabs gsum pa/bkra shis tshe ring gis spyi lo 2007 zla 1 tshes 7 nyin bod rang skyong ljongs zer ba'i mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen la phul ba'i snyan zhu/47༄cu//bkur 'os rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi 'thus mi rnams la/khyed rnam pa ni mi dmangs kyi sku tshab dang mi dmangs kyi khe phan ched du skad cha bshad mkhan yin la/ khyed rnam pas spyi tshogs gong 'phel dang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas gtong bar phan thogs pa'i las don mang po bsgrubs yod pa red/ der brten/ ngas khyed rnam par thugs rje che zhu yi yod/da thengs kyi 'phrin yig 'di'i nang don gtso bo ni/ bod kyi skad yig skor gyi gnad don yin pa dang / 'thus mi rnams kyis gnad don 'di so so'i bu rabs tsha rgyud kyi khe phan la gzhigs te mthong chen po gnang rgyu'i re ba yod/ bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i thad la /de snga phyi lo 1987 lor )((nges par du bod kyi skad yig gtso bor 'dzin pa'i thog /bod rgya skad yig mnyam spyod byed pa'i mdzad phyogs lag len bstar dgos/ bod kyi sa khul du rim pas bod kyi skad yig thog nas slob 'khrid byed pa'i slob gso'i ma lag 'dzugs rgyu sa zhes pa'i gal che'i thag gcod gnang ba der bskyar du zhib dpyad byed rgyu'i re ba yod/1987 lor bton pa'i yig cha de/ krung go deng rabs can du 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i spyi khyab bkod bsdoms pa ting zho phing dang / bod kyi rgyal yongs mi mang 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi

324 pha yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/tshogs gtso gzhon pa gnyis kyis rgyab skyor chen po'i 'og byung ba zhig red/ 'di ni bod mi dmangs dang bod kyi gong 'phel la phan pa'i bya ba bzang po zhig yin/'on kyang mi lo bco lnga phyin rjes kyi spyi lo 2002 lo'i zla 5 tshes 22 nyin gtan 'bebs byas pa'i na bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i gtan 'bebs 〉〉zhes pa'i nang du/ lag len bstar dgos pa'i zhib phra'i nang don gnad 'gag che ba de med pa bzos 'dug /nga rang gi bsam par 'di ni bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i gnad don thog lo 330 pha yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/'brel ba yod bsdad pa zhig yin pa dang / rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims dang khrims srol mang po'i nang du mi rigs 'dra mnyam yin par bshad kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin rigs slob grwar slob sbyong byed rwa 'i skabs su/ bod rigs dge rgan zhig gis nga la spyo deng skabs bod yig sbyangs na phan thogs yod pa ma red ces skad cha de 'dra bshad myong / mjug 'bras la kho
