gtong rgyu'i srid jus dang rgyab 'gal chags yod pa red/lo dgu'i 'os 'gan slob gso des/ rgya che ba'i rjes lus zhing 'brog mi mang gi bu phrug tsho'i phugs mdun la phan thogs chen po yod pa dang / des khong tsho'i shes yon gyi rmang gzhi yag po chags thub la/ tshan rig dang ched las kyang yag po sbyong thub/ lo dgu'i 'os 'gan slob gso lag bstar gyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni/ bod yig dang rgya yig gnyis kyi thog nas/ rang byung tshan rig sbyong rgyu med du mi rung ba zhig yin pa de red/nga rang la mtshon na/shes yon dang tshan rig gi lta grub ni/ngas slob gso'i las don sgrub pa'i skabs/ grub 'bras yag po byung ba'i gnad 'gag che ba'i rgyu rkyen yin pa dang / rgyu rkyen

334 pha yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/gzhan zhig ni/ nga rang gi yang dag pa'i mi tshe'i lta grub dang / lhag bsam rnam dag gis gtong phod kyi bsam blo de yin/ de tsho la brten nas zhing 'brog mi mang stong phrag mang po'i bu phrug la slob sbyong gi go skabs sprad yod/gnad 'gag nang gi gnad 'gag ni/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyis gom gang mdun spos kyis/ bod kyi skad yig thog nas slob 'khrid byed nga/'i slob gso'i lam lugs de lag bstar yag po zhig byas pa yin na/ zhing 'brog mi dmangs kyi bu phrug tshos/ bod yig dang rgya yig yag po sbyong thub par ma zad/ rang byung tshan rig kyang yag ngo/ sbyong thub pa 'di ni/ deng rabs kyi mkhas pa gso skyong byed pa'i cha rkyen gtso bo zhig yin pa red/ gal srid slob gso'i lam lugs 'di 'dra zhig yod na/ zhing 'brog mi dmangs kyi bu phrug tshos de bas slob sbyong yag po byed thub pa dang / 'cham mthun gyi spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang / deng rabs can mngon du 'gyur bar zhabs 'degs zhu yi red/shes yon rig gnas yod dus/ mi dmangs kyis so so'i thob thang dang 'os 'gan shes rtogs de bas gting zab pa yong thub kyi yod pa dang / 'di ni mi dmangs yongs kyi dngos yod gnas stangs dang thad kya'i khe phan la thug yod pa red/des 'dra mnyam dang lhag bsam/brtse sems bcas tshang ba'i dmangs gtso'i 'cham mthun gyi spyi tshogs 'dzugs pa la khag theg brtan po byed thub/ngas chung dus nas spyi tshogs dma' rim gyi dbul phongs la byams snying rje byed kyi yod/spyi tshogs la phan pa'i las don sgrub pa la bsam pa'i rmang gzhi yod par ma zad/ dngos su lag bstar byas te da bar rgyun 'khyongs byas pa tshang mas shes gsal red////

lhan thabs lnga pa/bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 'thus mi rnam nga ra phul ba'i 'phrin yig skor la bod tshol kha gsum gyi ched las mkhas pa rnam pa'i dgongs 'char/la /zhe༄༅// sku zhabs bkra shis tshe ring lags kyis bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 'thus mi rnam par phul ba'i 'phrin yig de nyid la/ gong rim 'brel yod kyis mchan bkod mdzub ston ltar /rgya nag )rgyal khab mi rigs don gcod u yon lhan khang gi dril bsgrags sde tshan nas phyi lo 2007 zla 7 tshes 7 nas 8 bar nyin gnyis ring pe cing du ched las mkhas pa'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du zhig ched du bskongs te/ slob grwa chen mo dang / tshan rtsal zhib 'jug khang /gsar 'gyur brgyud lam sogs sde tshan khag nas phebs pa'i chol kha gsum gyi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang rnam pas gnad don der go bsdur zhib nan lhug gsum gnang ba'i dgongs 'char phyogs bsdus byas pa khag gsham gsal/bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog mkhas dbang rnam pas phyi lo 1987 lor 'grems spel byas pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs su bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs 'ga' zhig (tshod lta'i lag bstar//ces pa dang / (gsham du gtan 'bebs rnying pa zhes 'god rgyu/) phyi lo 1988 lor 'grems bsgrags zhus pa'i don 'khyol byed phyogs kyi zhib srol/ phyi lo 2002 zla 5 tshes 22 nyin bod rang skyong ljongs skabs bdun pa'i dmangs 'thus tshogs 'du'i thog bskyar bcos gros 'cham byung ba'i bod rang skyong ljongs su bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu'i

336 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/gtan 'bebs 'ga' zhig /gsham du gtan 'bebs gsar pa zhes 'god rgyu//bcas zhib klog byas rjes gsal ston byas don/gtan 'bebs gsar pa dang rnying pa'i bar gyi nang don la he bag chen po shor zhing /gtan 'bebs rnying pa dang de'i don 'khyol byed phyogs zhib srol gyi nang don zhib cing phra ba yod par ma zad/ don dngos dang shin tu mthun pa zhig dang / bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas gtong bar phan rlabs chen po ldan la/ lag bstar byed bde zhig kyang yin/ de las gal 'gangs che ba zhig ni de rtsa khrims dang rang skyong khrims lugs sogs kyi 'brel yod gtan 'bebs dang mthun pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang gtan 'bebs rnying pa'i nang du bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong bar phan pa'i gal 'gangs che ba'i nang don mang dag cig 'khod pa rnams gtan 'bebs gsar pas nag bsub btang yod la/ nag bsub tu btang ba'i nang don de dag ni rgyal khab kyi mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi srid byus mtshon pa sha stag yin pas/ de ni gzhung 'brel gyi yig cha zhig gam lhag par du khrims lugs rang bzhin gyi yig cha zhig la nges par du tshang dgos pa zhig red/ gtan 'bebs gsar par don dngos dang mi mthun pa dang / rgyal khab kyi khrims srol srid jus dang mi mthun pa'i bzo bcos byed stangs des/ don dngos thog rtsa khrims dang mi rigs rang skyong khrims lugs sogs su gsal ba'i bod mi rigs kyis so so'i skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod byas chog pa'i thob thang dang rang dbang rnams med par bzos pa dang / des bod rang skyong ljongs su bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong bar ldog phyogs kyi nus pa chen po zhig thon thog /lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi gom pa chen po phyir bshol byas pa zhig kyang yin/ dmigs tshad de'i thad nas brjod na/ bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan sku zhabs bkra shis tshe ring lags kyis bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mi dmangs 'thus mi rnams la phul ba'i 'phrin yig de'i lta ba ni shin tu yang dag pa zhig red/ gtan 'bebs gsar pa'i nang lhag pa'i skyon gnad dang ldog phyogs kyi nus pa des phugs rgyang ring por bltas na bod kyi spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor brtan po'i ngang gong spel gtong bar phan nus med par ma zad/ mi rigs mthun sgril la'ang de bas phan nus med pa dang /'cham mthun gyi spyi tshogs skrun par phan thogs med pa/tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba don 'khyol 'byung bar phan thogs med pa'i byed stangs shig red/der brten/ bod kyi skad yig las don la mtshon na/ sku zhabs bkra shis tshe ring lags kyis gsal ston gnang ba'i gnad don de ni dus yun ring po zhig nas lhag pa'i gnad don

lhan thabs lda pa/ 337zhig dang / de ni bod mi rigs kyi skad yig dang rig gzhung mu mthud gnas thub min dang 'brel ba'i don chen zhig /rang rgyal gyi rgyal spyi'i mtshan mthong dang khe phan la 'brel ba yod pa'i don chen zhig yin stabs 'brel yod nas der do snang chen po gnang dgos par ma zad/rtsa khrims dang rang skyong khrims lugs kyi snying don gzhir bzung de mtshungs kyi bzo bcos gros 'char brgyud thag gcod legs po yong thabs byed dgos/gcig /gnad don dang rgyu mtshan/don tshan dang po/ nang khul du/1) phyi lo 2༷༷2 lo'i gtan 'bebs des mi rigs bar gyi 'gal rkyen slong sma ru bsgyur te mi rigs mthun sgril la gnod pa dang / brtan snying med pa'i rkyen ngan bslangs te 'cham mthun spyi tshogs skrun par ston gyi med/rsā༅// skad yig 'dra mnyam ni mi rigs 'dra mnyam srid jus nang gi ches gal 'gangs che ba'i nang don zhig yin/ lag len thog nas ra sprod gsal po byung don zhig la/ bkol shugs che ba'i skad yig cig dang bkol shugs chung ba'i skad yig cig cha rkyen gcig mtshungs 'og bed spyod byed du bcug na/ bkol shugs chung ba'i skad yig la drang po chags kyi med/ gang lags she na/ bkol shugs chung ba'i skad yig la srung skyob gang yang med pa'i rkyen gyis yin/bod kyi skad yig ni bod rigs mi 'bor gyis brgya cha 96zin pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs kyi spyi khyab skad yig yin pa ni smos mi dgos/ gtan 'bebs gsar pa'i nang bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong bar phan pa'i gal che ba'i nang don mang dag cig tag tag nag bsub btang yod stabs/ bod rigs mi 'bor brgya cha 96 yan zin pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dngos yod gnas tshul la bltas na/ skad yig gnas stangs la khyen yongs dang gting zab po'i sgo nas zhib 'jug byas pa'i tshan rig rang bzhin gyi gzhi rtsa med pa dang /dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi bsam blo'i lam ston med pa/de'i rkyen gyis bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong bar bkag rgya chen po bzos yod pa ni mngon gsal red/ der brten gtan 'bebs gsar pa'i ngo bo dngos ni phyir bshol byas pa zhig yin pa dang / des bod mi rigs kyis so so'i skad yi ga slob sbyong dang bed spyod gtang chog pa'i thob

338 sgyu yul gyi phrin bde'i ched du/thang 'phrog yod la/bod mi rigs kyi so so'i rig gzhung srung skyob dang rgyun 'dzin gyi thob thang yang btsan 'phrog byas yod/skad yig ni mi rigs shig gi srog rtsa yin zhing / bod kyi skad dang yi ge ni bod mi rigs la dmigs bsal du yod pa'i khyad nor zhig yin/ de ni bod kyi rig gzhung tshad dang ldan pa dang ji ma ji bzhin du 'god byed kyi gal 'gangs che ba'i brda rtags shig yin par ma zad/krung go'i rig gzhung gter mdzod nang gi nor bu khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin te/ rgya nag gi da pal yon dang /'dzam gling spyi'i dpal yon la'ang legs skyes chen po phul yod/der brten bod kyi skad yig rgyun 'dzin dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong bar brda sprod rig pa'i rin thang chen po ldan par ma zad/ phun sum tshogs pa'i mi rigs rig pa dang / rtsom rigs rig pa/lo rgyus rig pa bcas kyi rin thang yang chen po ldan/gal srid gtan 'bebs gsar pa ltar/ da lta nas bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong bar mthong chen ma byas na/ bod kyi skang yig de nyid rim bzhin bod rigs mi mang gi 'tsho ba'i khrod nas med par gyur te/ bod kyi rig gzhung gi sngar yod rmang gzhi rtsa brlag tu 'gyur rgyur ma zad/ sna 'dzoms gong bu gcig tu grub pa'i krung hwa rig gzhung gi cha shas gal 'gangs che ba zhig kyang med par 'gyur nges red/de lta bu'i rjes 'bras ni bod mi rigs kyi chag sgo zhig yin la/ krung hwa rig gzhung gi chag sgo zhig kyang yin/ der brten mi rigs kyi srog rtsar gnod pa dang mi rigs kyi brtse dung la gnod pa/ spyi tshogs kyi rig gzhung 'dzugs skrun la phan pa med pa'i byed stangs des/ spyi tshogs nang dgos med kyi mi mngon pa'i rkyen ngan bslangs te don med du spyi tshogs kyi 'gal zla bzo rgyu nges pa red/de 'dra yin phyir/ nga tshos tshor shugs drag po'i sgo nas re ba 'don rgyu zhig la/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyis bod rang skyong ljongs su bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs de nyid yang bskyar bskyar bcos byed skabs/ phyi lo 1987 lor 'grems bsgrags byas pa'i gtan 'bebs kyi gal che'i don tshan dang snying don rnams rang 'jags bzhag thog /bod rang skyong ljongs su brgya cha 96 yan bod rigs mang tshogs yin pa'i dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs te bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod la phan pa'i don tshan gsar snon dang / gtan 'bebs 'di nyid sngar bas 'thus sgo tshang ba dang lugs dang mthun pa/ sngar bas rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi khe phan dang mthun pa dang / tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba dang 'tsham pa zhig gnang ste/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mi rigs skad yig

340 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/pha skad kyi tshab byas te deng rabs can du bsgyur thabs byed kyi yod pa dang / 'di lta bu'i thal bskyod ring lugs kyi byed stangs ni g.yon thal bsam blos gnod skyon btang ba dngos su mtshon la/des slob gso 'phel rgyas gtong bar bkag rgya tshabs chen thebs kyi yod/2) 'gro ba mi'i bsam blo gtong phyogs dang ngos 'dzin byed phyogs kyi ngos nas bshad na/ pha skad brgyud shes bya sbyang rgyu ni ches phan nus ldan la ches tshan rig ldan pa'i thabs lam zhig yin par tshan rig zhib 'jug gi thog nas ra 'phrod gsal po byung yod pa dang /lag len dngos kyis kyang pha skad slob sbyong byas na phan nus dang grub 'bras mngon gsal yod pa gsal ston byas yod/ sku zhabs babakra shis tshe ring lags ni bod yig dang rgya yig /dbyin yig bcas yig rigs gsum la thogs pa med cing / khong gi nyams myong yin na'ang 'dra/yang na mkhas dbang rnam pa'i tshor snang zab mo yin na'ang 'dra/de bzhin du rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi mang gi mig mthong gzugs grub kyi myong tshor bcas gang la bltas na'ang / pha skad slob sbyong gi phan nus rang bzhin dang gal 'gangs rang bzhin ra sprod byed kyi yod/ gnad don de'i thad sku zhabs bkra shis tshe ring lags kyis bton gnang ba'i bsam 'char khag ni gal 'gangs chen po yin la/ khong gis rgyal khab dang /mes rgyal la bcangs pa'i lhag bsam dang / lo rgyus la 'gan khur ba'i snying gtam rnams kyis mi tshor sems 'gul chen po thebs la/rjes su yi rang zhu dgos pa zhig red/der brten/ pha skad min pa'i skad yig /dper na rgya skad sogs )cig gis pha skad (bod skad )kyi tshab byas te deng rabs can zhes pa slob 'khrid byed rgyu ni long ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa'am dngos don dang mi mthun pa'i byed stangs shig yin la/ lhag par du de ni g.yon thal bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun gyi thon rdzas shig yin phyir/ de'i rjes 'bras ni slob phrug rnams phyed rgya yig yig rmongs dang / phyed bod yig yig rmongs su gyur te/ skad yig gnyis ka khungs ma 'khye6 ba chags kyi yod/ de ltar mi rabs nas mi rabs su 'thus shor du phyin na/ bod rang skyong ljongs dang bod khul sa gnas gzhan dag tu deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun gyi shes ldan mi sna mi ldang ba'i dka' ngal tshabs chen 'phrad rgyu dang /rgyal khab kyi slob gso'i thon khungs dang / shes ldan mi sna'i thon khungs/ dpal 'byor bcas la'ang chud zos chen po zhig yin/ 'di dag ni phyi rol yul gyi don dngos la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i ngos 'dzin dang gdeng tshod med pa dang / tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas gzhung lugs kyi mdzub ston med pa'i mngon rtags yin stabs/ don gyi ngo bo

lhan thabs lda pa/ 341dngos ni pha skad slob 'khrid kyi thob thang 'phrog pa de yin/ rgya nag mi mang spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims kyi 'brel yod gtan 'bebs dang / ma le ring lugs dang ting zha'o phing gi gzhung lugs/mtshon byed gsum gyi snying don/de mtshungs dus rabs gas/ra pa'i nang bton gnang ba'i 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba bcas gzhi gang la bcol na'ang / mi rigs mthun sgril la gnod pa dang / mang tshogs dang rgyal khab kyi khe phan la gnod pa'i rgyu rkyen mtha' dag sa gnas 'go 'khrid las byed pa tshos nus shugs yod rgu rtsal sprugs gnang ste med pa bzo dgos pa las/ nor ba'i thog tu nor 'khrul gyi lam ston byas na mi 'grigs/phyi lo 1987 lor rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi u yon krang sku gzhon paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med rnam gnyis kyis gtso skyong dang / 'brel yod bod rigs las byed mnyam zhugs kyis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs su bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs 'ga' zhig(tshod lta )ces pa'i nang / bod kyi skad yig gtso bo 'dzin pa'i thog /bod rgya skad yig gnyis ka mnyam spyod byed pa'i mdzad phyogs lag bstar byas te/ bod rang skyong ljongs su bod kyi skad yig thog nas slob 'khrid byed rgyu gtso bor byed pa'i slob gso'i ma lag 'dzugs dgos zhes gal che ba'i thag gcod byas pa de ni rtsa khrims dang / rang skyong bca' khrims kyi 'brel yod gtan 'bebs dang yongs su mthun pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang / phyi lo 2002 zla 5 tshes 22 nyin bod rang skyong ljongs skabs bdun pa'i dmangs 'thus tshogs 'du'i thog bskyar bcos gros 'cham byung ba'i bod rang skyong ljongs su bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs nang / gal 'gangs che la don phan ldan pa'i thag gcod 'di nyid rbad de nag bsub btang yod/ de ni bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu'i thad lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi phyir bshol byas pa zhig yin par ma zad/don dngos thog rtsa khrims dang 'gal yod/nyan gal srid slob grwa'i nang du bod kyi skad yig slob 'khrid la shugs snon ma brgyab pa dang /bod kyi skad yig bkol spyod dang 'phel rgyas gtong bar rmang gzhi legs po zhig ma btsugs na/ mi rigs slob gso'i bya gzhag don snying ldan pa'i ngang 'phel rgyas gtong mi thub par ma zad/ de las ldog ste ldog phyogs kyi shugs rkyen ma nga das cig gi sne drangs te/

342 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/bod kyi skad yig rig gnas srung skyob dang rgyun 'dzin byed rgyu'ang ri nyil thag pas mi 'dum pa'i nyen kha'i mtshams su slebs nges/der brten bod kyi skad yig slob 'khrid byed rgyu de gal srid slob chung nas slob 'bring dang / de nas slob chen/ de las tshad mtho ba'i zhib 'jug slob ma dang / 'bum rams pa bcas theg pa rim 'dzegs kyi ma lag 'thus sgo tshang ba zhig med na/ rkang rten med pa'i mchongs bskyod kyi rang bzhin dang / bskyar zlos rang bzhin/ rang snang gang dran rang bzhin bcas yin pa'i mig rgyang thung ba'i slob gso'i srid byus des/ slob phrug rnams kyi bsam blo'i 'khyer so dang / skad yig /slob gso'i nang don bcas phan tshun mthud 'brel byed par dgos gal med pa'i 'gog rkyen dang dgos gal med pa'i rnyog 'dzing byung ste/ slob 'khrid kyi spus tshad je mthor gtong bar shugs rkyen tshabs chen thebs nges red/dper na/ gtan 'bebs gsar pas gtan 'bebs rnying pa'i nang gsal ba'i bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong skor gyi gal che'i don tshan la shugs ston brgyab med par ma zad/ gtan 'bebs rnying pa'i nang gsal ba'i gal che ba'i don tshan mang dag cig nag bsub btang yod/ byed stangs des khyen yongs nas bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong byed rgyu'i shugs tshad nyams dmas su btang ste/ bod kyi skad yig 'di nyid yod na'ang 'grig la med na'ang 'grig pa'i slob tshan zhig tu gyur yod/ gtan 'bebs gsar pa'i don tshan drug pa'i nang bkod don/ 'os 'gan slob gso'i dus rim du bod kyi skad yig dang /rgyal khab kyi spyi spyod skad yig (rgya yig la go dgos/ sgyur mchan//gnyis slob gso'i slob 'khrid kyi skad yig yin zhing / bod kyi skad yig dang /— rgyal khab kyi spyi spyod skad yig gi slob tshan 'dzugs rgyu dang / dus tshod ran 'tsham phyi rgyal skad yig gi slob tshan 'dzugs rgyu zhes gsal yod//'os 'gan slob gso zhes pa ni de sngon 'dzin rim drug pa man yin pa dang /da lta bod rang skyong ljongs su 'dzin rim dgu pa'i bar 'os 'gan slob gso khyab lugs dril bsgrags byed kyi yo da/ sgyur mchan/) 'on kyang / 'os 'gan slob gso'i dus rim skabs bod yig gi slob tshan khrid pa dang / mtho rim slob 'bring skabs /'dzin grwa bcu pa nas bcu gnyis bar la go dgos/sgyur mchan// rgya yig gcig pu'i thog nas slob tshan 'khrid pa yin na/ gnas stangs 'di sku zhabs bkra shis tshe ring lags kyis gsungs pa nang bzhin/ slob phrug mang po zhig gis bod rgya skad yig gnyis kyi nyer mkho'i cha lag

lhan thabs lnga pa/ 343phan tshun rtsa ba nas mthud mi thub par 'gyur ba'i dbang gis/ slob 'khrid kyi phan 'bras la gnod skyon tshabs chen bzo nges/de ni bod rang skyong ljongs su da yod slob 'bring dang slob chung khag nang slob phrug 457819 yod pa la mtshon na/ so so'i slob gso'i khe phan dang thad kur 'brel ba'i gnad don zhig yin par ma zad/ bod kyi skad yig bya gzhag bde blag ngang 'phel rgyas 'gro thub min dang 'brel ba'i don chen zhig kyang yin/gtan 'bebs gsar pas bod kyi skad yig 'di nyid yod na'ang 'grig la med na'ang 'grig pa'i gnas su skyel ba'i bsam sbyor des/ don dam du bod kyi skad yig dang de'i slob 'khrid rim bzhin slob gso rig pa'i lo rgyus kyi sdings cha'i sgang nas btsan shed kyis phyir 'then byed du 'jug pa yin la/ bod mi rigs kyi rig gzhung 'di nyid 'gro ba mi'i rig gzhung khrod nas btsan shed kyis rtsa yal du gtong du 'jug pa de yin/de dang chabs cig /byed stangs des mi rnams kyis bod kyi skad yig dang rig gzhung slob sbyong dang bed spyod/rgyun 'dzin/'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i rang dbang dang thob thang 'phrog ste/ rgya che'i bod rigs mi mang gi khe phan la gnod skyon thebs par ma zad/rtsa khrims dang rang skyong bca' khrims/ 'os 'gan slob gso'i khrims lugs bcas kyi dgongs don dang 'gal ba dang / rgyal khab kyi mi rigs srid byus dang 'gal gyi yod/gsum pa/ g.yon gyi bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun gyis da dung mu mthun gnod 'tshe gtong bzhin yod stabs/ gal srid dus thog dug rdzas de gtsang sel ma byas na/ mi dmangs dang rgyal khab gnyis zhar gnong skyon rdzogs rgyu med pa 'byung nges/ gtan 'bebs gsar pa ni g.yon bsgom bsam blo'i thon rdzas shig yin stabs/ de'i thad spyi chogs steng bsam tshul zhugs drag yod par ma zad/ mi rnams gting nas khong khro langs kyang kha nas bshad mi nod par gyur pa dang / gal srid rgyun du 'di ltar byas na 'cham mthun gyi spyi tshogs skrun par gnod skyon tshabs chen lhag nges/༄༅// sngon chad yin na bod rang skyong ljongs tsam ma zad/ bod khul sa gnas gzhan dag tu'ang bod kyi skad yig ni spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod spyi spyod skad yig gtso bo de yin/ lhag par du gzhung phyogs kyi yig rigs khag tu bod yig ni gtso bo yin pa bshad mi dgos pa zhig red/ 'on kyang /deng sang tag tag de las ldog pa'i gnas bab cig tu lhung yod/

344 pha yul gyi phrin bde'i ched du/de yang bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod kyi dngos yod phan 'bras dang khyab tshad kyang spyir btang tsam las med cing / bod rang skyong ljongs su de bas kyang yid skyo dgos pa zhig chags yod/ des sa gnas srid gzhung gis rgyal khab kyi mi rigs skad yig srid byus lag bstar don 'khyol ma byas pa mtshon gyi yod par ma zad/ rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims dang rang skyong bca' khrims/ 'os 'gan slob gso'i khrims lugs bcas kyis bod rigs la gnang ba'i so so'i skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyong/ srung skyob kyi thob thang dang rang dbang yod pa'ang brtsi srung dang 'gan len byas med pa mngon gsal du mtshon gyi yod/dper na/ mtho slob yig rgyugs gcig pur mtshon na/ bod kyi mi 'bor 'dus sdod che shos yin pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtho rim slob 'bring /'dzin grwa bcu pa nas bcu gnyis bar/ sgyur mchan/)gi bod yig chu tshad lo re las lo re sdug tu 'gro bzhin pa de/ rgya yig gis bod kyi skad yig gi tshab byas te slob 'khrid byas pa'i rjes 'bras las byung ba zhig yin/ ches ya mtshan dgos pa zhig la/ de 'dra'i rgya che ba'i bod rang skyong ljongs kyi slob phrug tsho'i bod yig chu tshad de/ a mdo sa khul gyi rang skyong khul chung chung zhig gi chu tshad las ha cang gis skyo ba chags yod pa dang / bod kyi rig gzhung lte gnas su grags pa'i lta sa grong khyer gyi slob phrug rnams kyi chu tshad de/ de'i mnga' 'og lto kha dang gzhis rtse sa khul las skyo ba chags yod/ gal srid bod kyi skad yig slob 'khrid la mthong chen dngos su byas yod na/ de lta bu'i khyad par chen po zhig yong mi srid/ don dngos thog rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rgya yig gis bod kyi skad yig gi tshab byas pa'i slob gso'i byed phyogs ni grab 'bras thob rgyu med pa'i dpe mtshon gson po zhig yin la/ lag len dngos kyi thog nasag kyang de ni tshan rig gzhung lugs kyi mdzub ston med pa'i spyod tshul zhig dang / g.yon thal bsam blos nor lam du khrid pa'i ngan 'bras shig yin par ra sprod gsal po byung yod/ 'on kyang gang zag bye brag pa 'ga' zhig gis da dung de lta bu'i grub 'bras thon rgyu med pa zhig bskyar du lag len bstar rgyur spro ba ches cher 'phel bzhin yod pas/ der rgyal khab 'brel yod tshan pas do snang chen po gnang dgos par ma zad/ lam nor du bskyar zhugs byed pa'i gnas tshul ma yong ba byas te mi rigs sa khul gyi slob gso'i las don bde blag ngang gong du 'phel bar gnod skyon mi 'byung ba gnang dgos/de mtshungs bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun de lta bu'i shugs rkyen 'og /bod kyi skad yig slob deb kyi nang don bkod sgrig kyang thog mtha' bar gsum nas gnad don zhig tu gyur te/ slob 'khrid kyi spus tshad dang grub 'bras la gnod skyon tshabs chen thebs kyin yo da/ bod kyi skad

346 pha yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/yod/mi dgos zhes dang / nga tshos deng rabs can gyi lcags smyug spyod pa las smyug bris (bod yig la zer gyi yod)mi dgos zhes bshad kyin yod/ g.yon thal can gyi rjod tshul de dag ni sa gnas 'go 'khrid las byed 'ga' zhig gi bsam blo'i ngos 'dzin g.yon thal ring lugs su phyogs bzhin pa dang / mtshon byed gsum dang 'cham mthun gyi spyi tshogs skrun dgos pa'i ches mtho'i snying don nan tan gyis lag len mthar phyin ma byas pa/ rgya che'i mi mang gi khe phan ang dang por ma rtsis pa bcas mngon gsal du mtshon pa zhig red/gong du brjod pa ltar 'brel yod rgyal khab kyi srid byus dang khrims srol bed spyod byas te/mi dmangs la rnam pa 'gyur ba'i 'gog gnon dang rdung rdeg /mgo skor bslu brid gtong ba'i byed stangs des rgyun ldan rtsa ba nas min pa'i khor yug cig bskrun te/ mi mang po zhig bzod sgom mi thub pa dang / ci bya gtol med du gyur pa/ tha na skad cha bshad rgyu'i thob thang yang 'phrog nas spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong bar gnod pa'i mi mngon pa'i 'gal rkyen sna tshogs skrun bzhin yod/'gro ba mi'i lo rgyus 'phel rim khrod/ mi lo 5༷༷༷ lhag gi lo rgyus ldan pa'i rgya'i skad yig dang / mi lo 4000 lhag gi lo rgyus ldan pa'i bod kyi skad yig gnyis kyi phan nus dang byas rjes ni gal che chung gcig pa yin/ bod kyi sa khul du/ gal srid bod kyi skad yig dor ba de deng rabs can du 'gyur ba'i rin dod du brtsi dgos na/ de ni rin dod shin tu che ba zhig yin par ma zad/ ma le ring lugs kyis skad yig 'dra mnyam ni mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi mtshon byed yin pa'i rtsa ba'i rtsa don dang 'gal ba zhig dang / rgya nag mi mang spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims dang / rang skyong bca' khrims su gsal ba'i 'brel yod gtan 'bebs dang de bas 'gal ba zhig yin/ de lta bu'i nor 'khrul tshabs chen zhig gal srid nga chos tang krung dbyang gis zing bcos yo bsrang dang rtsa ba'i thog nas bsgyur bcos byed dgos pa'i bka' dgongs ltar dus thog yo bsung mthil phyin ma byas na/ 'cham mthun gyi spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba lag len bstar bar shugs rkyen tshabs chen thebs rgyu yin par ma zad/ rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs kyis rang rer kha rdung gtong ba'i lag cha zhig tu'ang 'gyur nges red/der brten/ g.yon gyi bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun dang rjod tshul gang zhig yin rung tshang ma tshan rig dang rgyab 'gal dang / don dngos dang 'gre/la ba ltag sprod du gyur pa zhig yin phyir/de'i rjes 'bras ni shin tu tshabs chen yin te/ bod rang skyong ljongs dang bod rigs 'dus

lhan thabs lnga pa 347sdod sa khul yongs kyi sa gnas srid gzhung gis nges par du rgyal khab kyi srid byus dang khrims srol ltar/ gzhi rim mang tshogs su dngos su bskyod de khong tsho'i bsam 'char nyan 'jog dang /deng rabs can du 'gyur ba'i brgyud rim khrod dngos thog bden 'tshol gyis bod kyi skad yig la gal che'i nus pa 'don bcug ste/ de nyid bod kyi rig gzhung gi rmang gzhi dang / bod deng rabs can du 'gyur ba'i mtshon byed du 'gyur dgos//bzhi pa/ bod kyi skad yig bkol spyod kyi khyab khongs chung du btang ba de bod yig sbyangs na bed med dang / las zla mi rag pa/ mtho spob tu rgyugs 'phrod dala' ba bcas 'bur du thon pa'i spyi tshogs gnad don dang thad lar 'brel ba chags shing / de'i rkyen rtsa gtso bo ni sa gnas gzhung gis bod kyi skad yig la mazong mi 'jog pa'i g.yon thal bsam blo'i rkyen gyis byung ba zhig yin stabs/ des rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi dmangs kyi bde rtsar thug pa'i khe ston dang mi rigs kyi brtse dung la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen bzos te/ mang tshogs kyis dbus gzhung gi srid byus la go nor thebs sla la/ 'cham mthun gyi sbi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed par ston med gnod che rtag cig tu gyur yod/ ོ༄༅// bod kyi skad yig bed spyod gtong sa'i khyab khongs je chung je chung du 'gyur bzhin yod/de ni bod kyi las rigs khag tu bod kyi skad yig bed spyod gtong ba'i khor yug dang gtan 'bebs med pa'i rkyen las byung ba zhig yin/dang thog bod kyi rig gzhung gi lte bar grags pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs su/ bod rigs mang tshogs rnams so so'i pha tsha bu rgyud rnams rang nyid kyi skad yig slob sbyong byas rjes/ rang mi rigs kyis brgya cha 96 yan zin pa 'i pha yul du las ka ma rag pa'i rkyen gyis bde bar gnas thabs med pa'i sdug bsngal 'og lhung bsdad yod/ de ni mang tshogs kyis go ba len thabs dka' la gnam 'og gi mi rnams kyis bzhad gad kyi gnas su gyur pa 'i bya ba khyad mtshar po zhig dang / gzhan gyis rang re'i rgyal khab la rgol rdung gtong byed kyi lag cha legs shos shig 'gyur ba ma reng dam/ mtho slob rgyugs sprod kyi ang ki de'ang gnad don gal che zhig chags kyi yod/ tshang mas mkhyen gresal ltar/ mtho slob rgyugs sprod de mi re ngos rer bshad na mi tshe'i nang gi gal che ba'i kha phyogs 'gyur mtshams shig la brtsi yi yo da/ der brten/ slob phrug rnams kyi lang tsho dar la babs pa'i rtsa che'i dus tshod yin na'ang 'dra/ yang na lo mang

348 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/ring nang mi rnams kyis dpal 'byor dang sems shugs kyi rgyab skyor thog slob grwa'i dge rgan rnam pas dka' spyad kyis gso skyong gnang ba bcas gang yin rung / de ni slob phrug gi slob gso'i khe phan gnad don dang 'brel ba zhig yin par ma zad/ rgan rabs spun nye re re'i don dam pa'i khe phan gyi gnad don dang 'brel ba zhig kyang yin/ 'on kyang / bod rang skyong ljongs su spyir btang mtho slob rgyugs sprod skabs/ bod yig la brgya cha 50 ma gtogs sprod kyi med pa dang /tha na skabs 'gar da dung mtho slob rgyugs sprod kyi brgya char rtsa ba na/ rtsis 'gro gtong gi med/de lta bu'i gcog cha byed stangs ni mi rnams go ba len thabs dka' ba'i bya ba khyad mtshar zhig yin pa dang / nan tan du brjod na/ phar bltas na phru ga'i rtsed mo lta bu de/ don dngos su bod kyi skad yig dang de'i slob 'khrid la dma' 'bebs dang / bod kyi skad yig rig gnas la mthong chung / lhag par du slob gso'i las don la snang chung btang ba'i bya spyod cig chags yod/gal srid de ltar mu mthud phyin na/ de lta bu'i nan tan min pa dang / dngos yod gnas stangs la brtsi 'jog mi byed pa/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba'i gzhung lugs kyis mdzub ston med pa'i bsam blo'i 'khyer sos bod kyi mi rigs slob gsoli las don de nyid 'thor shig tu gtang gi ma red dam/de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/dmigs yul gang gi ched du yin nam/yang bskyar brjod dgos pa zhig la/ tshad ldan mtho slob tu brtsi ba'i bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i nang / lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i lo 'gor bod kyi skad yig ched sbyong tshan khag med pa bzos pa'i gnas tshul byung myong ba ma zad/ tshad ldan bod yig dge rgan mang dag cig dge rgan gyi go gnas nas kha gyes su bcug yod/ dus rabs gsar pa 'go btsugs ma thag /bod ljongs slob grwa chen mos yang glo bur du lo gnyis tsam ring bod yig ched sbyong 'dzin grwa bsdu mtshams bzhag pa'i gnas tshul byung yod/ de lta bu'i gtan 'jags min pa'i srid byus des rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi mang gi slob phrug gi bde rtsar thug pa'i slob gso'i khe phan la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog par ma zad/ dus mtshungs de ni bod kyi skad yig la mthong chung dma' 'bebs dang brtsi mthong mi byed pa mtshon gyi yod/slob grwa ni spyi tshogs la phul byung mi sna gso skyong dang phyir gtong bya yul gyi shes bya'i 'thab ra zhig yin stabs/slob gso'i byed phyogs srid byus rang snang gang dran gyis 'gyur ldog gtong mi rung la/ thog mtha' bar gsum du rgyal khab dang mi dmangs kyi rtsa ba'i khe phan bsgrub bya ang dang por brtsis te khur 'gan mchog tu gyur pa sgrub dgos/ gal srid gal che ba'i slob grwa'i slob gso'i khyab khongs su bod kyi skad yig bkol spyod dang 'phel rgyas la mu mthud

lhan thabs lnga pa/ 349bkag 'dzin byas na/ de'i rjes 'bras ni ma 'ongs par bod mi rnams bod yig sbyong dgos na yang bskyar dgon par 'gro dgos pa dang / yang na phyi rgyal ba 'ga' zhig gis gsungs pa ltar/nub phyogs su bskyod de khong tsho'i mnyam sbyangs dgos pa chags nges/ gal srid dngos 'brel dus tshod de lta bu zhig shar tshe/ de ni 'dzam bu gling gis nga tsho bod kyi skad yig gi pha yul du bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod kyi thob thang dang rang dbang 'gan srung mi thub pa'i 'phya lad bya yul zhig tu 'gyur gyi ma red dam/ de lta bu'i tshabs che'i lo rgyus kyi 'gan sus khur thub bam/ der brten/ gal srid gtan 'bebs gsar pa bskyar du bzo bcos bya skabs/spyi yongs dang phugs rgyang ring po/rgyal khab dang mi mang gi khe phan la dmigs pa'i tshad gzhi'i sgang nas bod kyi skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum la phan pa'i don tshan dang nang don gtan 'bebs byed thub na/ de ni bod kyi spyi tshogs brtan po'i sgo nas gong 'phel gtong ba'i dngos yod dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa zhig dang / bod rang skyong ljongs su brgya cha 96 yan bod rigs yin pa'i dngos yod gnas stangs dang mthun pa/ bod rang skyong ljongs su brgya cha 80lhag zhing 'brog mi dmangs yin pas khong tsho'i rtsa ba'i khe phan dang mthun pa zhig kyang yin/de bzhin bod rang skyong ljongs su nga tshos zhabs 'degs zhu yul gtso bo rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi dmangs yin pa gsal po mkhyen dgos/ nga tsho'i mtho slob mang che ba ma 'ongs par thad kur gzhi rim zhing 'brog mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du bskyod dgos shing / gal srid rgya'i skad yig gcig pu ma gtogs shes kyi med na phan tshun go brda 'phrod thub kyi med pa dang / de'i rkyen gyis don dam du zam pa lta bu'i nus pa thon mi thub / skad yig gis phan tshun 'brel 'dris byed rgyur 'gog rkyen bzos par ma zad/ de las gal che ba zhig ni las kya'i thog dka' ngal 'phrad yong gi yod/ bod rigs las byed mang dag cis gzhi rim du bskyod skabs bod skad thog tshogs 'du gtso skyong byed mi thub pa dang / bod skad cha tshang ba zhig mi shes pa'i rkyen gyis zhing 'brog mi dmangs dang kha brda byed thub kyi med par brten/ mi rigs las byed cig la dgos nges kyi nus pa brlags par gyur yod/ de ni sku zhabs bkra shis tshe ring lags kyis rgya min bod min nya nyung mnyam bsres kyi skad yig ces gsungs pa ltar/ des rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi dmangs la krung dbyang gi srid byus khyab bsgrags dang 'grel brjod tshad dang ldan pa byed thabs bral bar brten/ 'brel thag lta bu'i nus pa 'don ga la thub/lhag par du bod khul gyi sa cha gang du phyin rung / 'grim 'grul dang me skyon sngon 'gog sogs bod yig thog gi khyab bsgrags ha lam mthong yul du med cing / sa gnas 'ga' zhig

350 pha yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/tu khyab bsgrags par ris chen po de 'dra yod kyang rgya yig gcig pu dang / nags ri srung skyob dang me skyon sngon 'gog gi khyab bsgrags chen po de 'dra dang / tha na lam rtags yi ge yang rgya yig gcig pu yin/ sa gnas kha shas su rgya mi ha lam mthong lam du med kyang dril bsgrags yig cha tshang ma rgya yig yin zhing / de dag su'i ched du zhabs zhu bslab kyi yod pa shes kyi mi 'dug / rumi rigs shig gi skad dang yi ge ni mi rigs de'i spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung / 'tsho ba bcas dang bde sdug mnyam myong dang shi gson mnyam gnas chags kyi yod/ de ni mi rnams phan tshun 'brel ba spel res dang / bsam blo gtong phyogs kyi yo byad cig yin la/slob grwar tshan rig dang mthun pa'i thabs shes legs shos 'di nyid bed spyod byas te slob sbyong gi grub 'bras je mthor gtong byed dang / shes bya yon tan gang mang thob pa'i yo byad cig kyang yin par ma zad/ mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gzhung rgyun 'dzin dang deng rabs can mngon du 'gyur ba'i mtshon byed cig kyang yin/der brten gtan 'bebs gsar pas ma mtha'i go don 'di dag kyang snang med du btang yod pa ni smos med red/de 'dra yin phyir/ sa gnas gzhung gi ngos nas bod mi rigs kyis bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong ba dang / mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gzhung slob sbyong dang rgyun 'dzin byed pa de rgyal khab kyi brtan snying la gnod pa'i nyen kha zhig la brtsi yi yod dam/ yang na rang rgyal gyi khrims lugs khrims srol dang mi mthun pa zhig dang / rang rgyal gyi mi rigs srid byus dang mi mthun pa zhig la brtsi yi yod/ de ltar min na/ gong bkod ltar bod kyi skad yig la bkag 'dzin 'dra min sna tshogs byas pa'i spyod tshul dang gtan 'bebs ga nas yong srid/ gting zab po'i sgang nas bltas na/ byed stangs de ni don dngos thog mi mang mang tshogs khrod rang re'i tang gi gzugs brnyan la gnod pa zhig dang / rgyal spyi'i thog krung go gung khran tang gi snyan grags la gnod pa/ rgyal khab dang mi dmangs kyi khe phan la gnod pa'i byed stangs shig red/ byed stangs de rigs kyis yang snying bod rigs mi mang chos dbus gzhung gi srid byus dang sems khur la sngar bas bka' drin bsam shes byed par zam pa lta bu zhig 'dzugs kyi yod dam/ yang na rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs dang dbus gzhung bar rang bzhin gyis 'gal rkyen slong gi yod/ rang rgyal ni mi rigs mang ba'i rgyal khab cig yin/ tang dang rgyal khab bar gyi 'brel bar gtor skyon tshabs chen btang ba'i byed stangs de rigs la/ gal srid 'brel yod sde tshan nas dus thog mtshams 'jog dang yo bsrang byed

lhan thabs lda pa/ 351du ma bcug na/ rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs/ mi rigs bar gyi 'cham mthun la chag sgo chen po zhig slong nges/(lnga pa chad yod/'od zer gyi drwa rgya'i nang du'ang gcig mtshungs chad 'dug/nang don la bltas na phal che ang ki 'god nor shor ba min nam snyam/sgyur mchan/)drug pa/ bod kyi skad yig tshad ldan can du bsgyur rgyu de ni kha tsha dgos gtub/sa shig chags par ma zad/ dus mtshungs su bod kyi skad yig bde blag ngang 'phel rgyas 'gro min la 'brel ba chags yod/ de ni rgyal khab kyi mdzad byus kho nar brten nas gzhi nas 'gan srung thub pa zhig yin stabs/ gtan 'bebs gsar pas bod kyi skad yig la dngos su 'phrad pa'i dka' ngal la mthong chen byed dgos pa las snang thung du gtong mi rung /༅༅// bod rigs kyi gcig gyur yi ge de nyid rgya yig dang gcig mtshungs kha skad las 'das pa'i yi ge zhig yin/ 'on kyang gcig gyur gyi yi ge dang kha skad bar gom bgrod gcig mtshungs chags med par ma zad/ tha na ya bral du gyur yod/ gal srid de mur 'gro bcug na bod kyi skad yig bkol spyod dang 'phel rgyas la phan pa med pa ni mngon gsal red/ der brten mi rigs kyi kha skad tshad ldan zhig khyab gdal dang gcig gyur bzo rgyu'i gnad don nga tsho'i mdun du lhag yod/1) bod skad skad gdangs tshad ldan skor gyi gnad don/bod chol kha gsum gyi skad gdangs dang / chol kha re re'i nang du yul skad sna min yod pa tshang ma bsdoms na bod skad du yul skad che chung bcu phrag kha shas yod pa ni smos med red/ bod kyi gtam dper bla ma rer chos lugs re/ lung pa rer skad lugs re zhes pa des bod khul du yul skad dang kha skad sna tshogs yod pa bstan yod/ der brten slob 'khrid dang / dril bsgrags/ 'brel ba spel res bcas stabs bde yong ba'i ched du/ bod skad kyi thun mong du spyod pa'i tshad ldan sgra gdangs shig gtan 'bebs byas te/ rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs la rgyal khab kyis gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i tshad ldan kha skad sgra gdangs shig yod pa byed dgos/ da lta'i char dbus slob gso pu'u sogs kyis rgyab skyor 'og bod rang skyong ljongs kyi bod kyi skad yig las don u yon lhan khang nas las don

352 pha yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/'bor chen bsgrubs yod par ma zad / zin bris gnad bsdus shig kyang bzos zin stabs/rgyal khab kyi 'brel yo da lhan khang nas mu mthud rgyab skyor gnang ste/ zin bris de dngos su 'grems bsgrags dang lag len bstar thub pa'i re ba zhu rgyu yin/2) tha snyad gsar pa gcig gyur dang tshad ldan can du bsgyur dgos/da lta'i char bod khul du 'phral du thag gcod byed dgos pa'i gnad don gal che zhig ni tha snyad gsar pa bod bsgyur thad gcig gyur med pa dang / tshad ldan med pa'i gnad don de yin pa dang / dus mtshungs su don gcig ming gi rnam grangs dang 'bri srol mi 'dra ba'i yi ge rnying pa'i rigs kyang tshad ldan du bsgyur rgyu shin tu gal che/ lhag par du tshig mdzod khag tu de'i rigs kyi nor 'khrul shin tu mang /de min thag gcod byed dgos pa zhig ni/ rgyal khab kyis tshig mdzod rtsom sgrig dang dag bcos kyi las don dus kyi 'gyur ba dang 'tsham pa'i rjes zin mi thub par brten/ da lta'i char bod khul sa gnas mi nyung ba zhig tu so sos mi sna rtsa 'dzugs byas te bod yig gi tshig mdzod 'dra min gsar rtsom byed kyi yod pa dang / de'i khrod du chos lugs mi sna'ang gang 'tshams shig yod/ chos lugs mi sna rnams la rgyu dngul yod stabs/ kho tshos so so'i rtsom sgrig byas pa'i tshig mdzod rnams bod khul du rin med bkrams te/ so so'i shugs rkyen mtho ru gtong gi yod/ yin na'ang kho tshos bed spyod byed bzhin pa'i tha snyad gsar pa de dag kyang khong tsho so sos sgra bsgyur dang gsar bzo byas pa sha stag yin stabs/ tshig mdzod gsar pa gcig gyur dang tshad ldan can du bsgyur rgyu kha tsha dgos gtugs su gyur yod/3) gcig gyur dang tshad ldan can gyi bod yig slob deb shin tu dkon/tha snyad gcig gyur dang tshad ldan can med par brten/ slob grwa khag nas so sos rtsom sgrig bgyis pa'i slob deb khag kyang gcig gyur dang tshad ldan chags kyi med/ slob deb de dag gtso bo chab srid dang / khrims lugs/ dpal 'byor/ tshan rig bcas thad kyi slob deb rnams yin/ dper na rgyal yongs su khrims lugs yig rgyugs btang ba'i khrod/ dbus khrims 'dzin las khungs kyis rgyugs shog sog yig dang / yu gur gyi yi ge/ ha sag kha'i yi ge bcas su phab bsgyur byas yod kyang bod yig tu phab bsgyur byas med/ de ni khrims lugs tha snyad kyang bod khul du sa gnas so sos bsgyur te/ gcig gyur dang tshad ldan med pa'i rkyen gyis yin/

lhan thabs lnga pa/ 353don tshan gnyis pa/ phyi phyogs su/dang po/ bod kyi skad yig nyams dmas su btang ba de thog mtha' bar gsum du rgyal spyi'i steng dgra 'dzin stobs thugs kyis krung gor rgol rdung gtong byed kyi lag cha gtso bro zhig yin/༅༅// dus yun ring po nas bzung rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs kyis rang rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi skad yig gi srid byus dang khrims srol la do snang chen po byed kyi yod/ de gang yin zer na/skad dang yi ge'i gnad don ni mi rigs 'dra mnyam mtshon byed dang / mi rigs kyi rang skad thob thang la brtsi 'jog byed min gyi ches rtsa ba dang ches gal 'gangs che shos kyi mtshon rtags shig yin la/ mi rigs shig gi khyad chos gal che shos shig kyang yin stabs/ mi rigs kyi skad yig ni mi rigs de'i bla srog tu gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de la thug yod/ 2002 lo'i gtan 'bebs kyis bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod byas na'ang 'grig la ma byas na'ang 'grig pa'i gnas bab tu bzhag pa des/ krung go dgra bor 'dzin pa'i stobs shugs la/ tag tag krung gor rgol rdung gtong ba'i kha g.yar sa zhig mkho sprod byas yod/ lhag par du rgyal spyi'i tshogs 'du 'ga' zhig tu'ang srid byus de dag bed spyod byas te rang rgyal la dma' 'bebs thengs kha shas byas yod pas/ krung ge'i rgyal spyi'i thog gi mtshan snyan grags dang brtsi mthong la ldog phyogs kyi shugs rkyen ngan pa bskrun yod/gnyis pa/ deng sang gi 'jig rten 'dir rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs kyis rtsa stongs 'gro la nye ba'i skad yig gnas tshul la do snang byed tshad shugs che ru 'gro bzhin pa des kyang rang rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi skad dang yi ge'i srid jus dang khrims srol la'ang do snang zhe cher 'gro yi yod/༄༅// skad yig gang 'dra zhig rtsa stongs su gyur na'ang des 'gro ba mi'i rig gzhung spyi la gsab thabs med pa'i gyong gun ster nges/de 'dra yin stabs/rang rgyal la sngar nas mi rigs kyi skad yig la mthong chen byed pa'i srol rgyun bzang po yod cing / rang rgyal gyi rtsa khrims nas

354 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/rang skyong bca' khrims/ 'os 'gan slob gso'i khrims lugs bcas su rtsod med yongs khyab kyi sgo nas mi rigs skad yig la srung skyob dang rgyab skyor gyi 'brel yod gtan 'bebs gsal po bkod yod/ der brten gtan 'bebs rnying pa dang de'i don 'khyol byed phyogs kyi zhib srol gyis kyang nan tan sgam brling ngang bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong ba la phan pa'i don tshan tshan rig dang ldan pa dang / don dngos dang 'tsham pa/ lag len bstar bde ba mang po zhig gtan 'bebs byas yod/ 'brel yod zhib 'jug tshan pa'i zhib 'jug snyan thor gzhigs na/ skad yig rtsa stong smi su 'gyur bzhin pa'i 'phel phyogs de/da lta rtsa brlag tu 'gyur la nye ba'i skad yig gcig pu'i gyong gun min par/ dus mtshungs su da lta thun mong du spyod bzhin pa'i skad yig che rigs khag la'ang thad kur shugs rkyen thebs yod pa bstan yod/ skad yig rig pa mkhas can tshos da lta 'dzam bu gling du spyod bzhin pa'i skad yig 'dra min 6000lhas/ yod pa nas dus rabs 'di'i nang brgya cha 50 nas 90 tsam rbad de rtsa brlags su 'gro nges yin pa'i tshod dpag byas yod/ 'o na/ gal srid tshod dpag 'di mngon sum du 'gyur na/ da lta mnga' khongs mi 'dra ba dang rim pa mi 'dra ba'i nang thun mong du spyod bzhin pa'i skad yig ji tsam ma 'ongs par rtsa brlag tu 'gyur ba'i nyen kha yod pa ma red dam/ dngos yod gnas stangs der bltas te/ da lta'i skad yig che rigs rnams kyis da dung do snang rtsa ba nas med pa'i ngang rtsa stongs su 'gyur la nye ba'i skad yig gnad don de rang nyid dang 'brel ba spu tsam med pa dang / de ni skad yig chung rigs rnams kyi sems khral kho na yin par ngos 'dzin gnang thub bam/nyen kha de bod kyi skad yig la'ang dmigs bsal med pa a cang cang / gtan 'bebs gsar pas bod kyi skad yig la bkag rgya byas te/ gal srid mtha' mjug bod kyi skad yig de nyid bod rigs kyi pha yul du med par gyur na/ de nas dngos 'brel phyi rgyal mkhas dbang 'ga' zhig gis 'phya smod dang ma 'ongs lung bstan byas pa de dngos su yong nges red/ phyi rgyal ba tshos ma 'ongs par bod rigs rnams bod kyi skad yig sbyangs dgos na nub phyogs su phyi rgyal ba'i mnyam du sbyong bar 'gro dgos zhes pa'i skad cha bshad pa der bsam gzhig nan po byed dgos pa zhig red/ der brten bod kyi skad yig las don thad bshad na/ nges par du ma lag yongs su ldan pa dang / don dngos dang mthun pa/ rgya che'i gzhi rim gyi dngos yod gnas stangs la zhib 'jug mthil phyen byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog /rgyal khab dang mi dmangs kyi khe phan ladamigs te gzigs rgyang mthon po dang / phugs rgyang ring po'i 'thab byus bsam blo'i

lhan thabs lda pa/ 355mdzub ston 'og/bod kyi skad yig gong 'phel du gtong bar skul spel thub pa'i gtan 'bebs shig bzo thub dgos/don tshan gsum pa/ thabs byus dang bsam 'char/༅༅// bod rang skyong ljongs kyis bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs gsar pa de ni bod kyi skad dang yi ge/ rig gzhung bcas kyi las dbang dang 'brel ba'i gnad don zhig dang / rgya che'i bod rigs zhing 'brog mi mang gi khe phan dngos dang 'brel ba'i gnad don zhig yin par ma zad/ rgyal khab kyi mi rigs srid byus dang /rtsa khrims/ rang skyong bca' khrims/ 'os 'gan slob gso'i khrims lugs bcas su gsal ba'i mi rigs khag 'dra mnyam thog so so'i skad dang yi ge bed spyod chog pa'i thob thang dang rang dbang yod ces par brtsi 'jog dang srung skyob/ lag len don 'khyol byed min dang 'brel ba'i gnad don zhig yin/ rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs kyis thog mtha' bar gsum du rang rgyal gyis da lta lag bstar byed bzhin pa'i mi rigs srid byus dang / khyad par du mngon gsal 'bur du thon pa'i skad dang yi ge'i srid byus la do snang byed bzhin pa'i gnad don dang 'brel ba dam po yod stabs/ tshogs zhugs khyad las mkhas dbang rnams nas gsham gsal gal che ba'i dgongs 'char khag bton yod/dang po/ phyi lo 1987 lo'i gtan 'bebs kyi snying don dang de'i don 'khyol byed phyogs kyi zhib srol la shugs snon dang lag bstar mthar phyin byed dgos par ma zad/ bod rang skyong ljongs su bod rigs mi 'bor gyis brgya cha 96zin pa'i dngos yod gnas stangs la gzhigs te bod kyi skad yig gong spel gtong bar phan pa'i don tshan gsar snon byed dgos/ de ltar byed thub na/ don dam thog bod kyi skad yig las don la sngar bas shugs snon thebs rgyu dang /bod kyi skad yig yun gnas thub pa dang gong spel gtong bar don dam gyi don sbing ldan pa zhig chags thub/ lhag par du des rgyal khab kyi mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi srid byus sdin 'khyol byung ba mtshon gyi yod pa dang / rtsa khrims dang rang skyong bca' khrim sa/ 'os 'gan slob gso'i khrims lugs bcas su gsal ba'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi skad yig srung skyob dang bed spyod thad bstsal ba'i khyad du 'phags pa'i thob thang dang rang dbang la 'gan srung byas pa mtshon

356 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/gyi yod stabs/ rgya che'i bod rigs zhing 'brog mang tshogs rnams blo bde bag phebs ngang 'tsho gnas thub pa dang / bod kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas brtan po yong ba/ rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs kyis kyang rang rgyal gyi mi rigs srid byus la skyon 'dogs byed sa med pa chags nges red/gnyis pa/ mang tshogs kyis lta bskul gang legs thub pa'i lam lugs bskrun te/ dbus gzhung gi srid byus sa gnas su don 'khyol lag bstar thub pa byed dgos/gsum pa/ bod rang skyong ljongs mi mang 'thus tshogs kyis bskyar bcos gros 'char bton te/ bod kyi skad yig thog slob 'khrid byed pa'i slob gso'i lam lugs 'dzugs dgos zhes pa'i thag gcod de bskyar gso thub nga 'i re ba zhu yi yod/de ltar byung na/ khrims srol gyis lam lugs 'gan len dang khag theg byed thub kyi yod la/bod rigs slob phrug rnams slob 'bring dang /lhag par du mtho 'bring dang slob grwa chen mo khag tu skad yig gnyis thog rang byung tshan rig gi slob tshan khag sbyangs thub par 'gyur nges/de ni yongs su tshul mthun lugs mthun zhig yin/rgya nag nang sar dpe blangs te sngon 'gro'i slob gso skabs nas bod yig slob dgos pa dang / de nas slob chung du pha skad kyi chu tshad nges can zhig tu slebs skabs gzhi nas rgya'i skad yig slob 'khrid byed dgos/ de ltar byed thub na/ slob 'bring dang mtho 'bring skabs bod kyi skad yig slob 'khrid gtso bor bzung thog /bod rgya skad yig gnyis ka mnyam spyod byed pa'i mdzad phyogs lag bstar byas te/ slob phrug rnams kyi bod rgya skad yig gnyis ku'i chu tshad sngon dpag byas pa'i phan 'bras ltar yong thub pa byed dgos/ de ni slob gso'i tshan rig dang bsam pa'i ngos 'dzin gyi tshan rig dang mthun pa zhig yin/dper na/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang / bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi spyi khyab byus 'god pa ting zha'o phing dang / rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi bod rigs u yon krang rnam pa gnyis (parṇa chen rin po che dang nga phod la zer/ sgyur mchan )bcas kyi gzigs skyong chen po'i 'og /bod kyi skad yig la phugs yun ring po'i 'phel rgyas dang /bod ljongs kyi mi rigs khag gi pha tsha bu rgyud rnams kyi bde rtsar thug pa'i khe phan de/ las don yongs kyi gzhi rten sa dang 'go tshugs sar brtsis te/ phyi lo 1987 lor bod rang skyong ljongs su bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs 'ga' zhig (tshod blta /ces pa de gtan 'bebs 'grems bsgrags byas yod par ma zad/ 1988 lor de'i don 'khyol byed phyogs kyi zhib srol yang gtan 'bebs 'grems bsgrags gnang yod/gtan 'bebs de'i nang du bod kyi skad yig gis slob 'khrid byed rgyu gtso bor 'dzin pa'i

lhan thabs lnga pa/ 357slob 'khrid kyi ma lag btsugs pa brgyud/ bod ljongs spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkhor dmigs pa'i mi sna gso skyong dang / bod kyi rig gzhung rgyun 'dzin thad 'gan 'khyer thub pa'i mi rigs kyi khyad las mi sna gso skyong byed rgyu dmigs yul gtso bor bzung ste/ gtan 'bebs kyi don tshan bco lnga nas nyer bdun bar bod kyi skad yig gong du spel ba'i dngos yod dgos mkhor dmigs nas/ bod ljongs su slob chung dang slob 'bring / rgya nag nang sa'i bod ljongs 'dzin grwa/ bod ljongs su slob chen dang 'bring rim ched las slob grwa bcas su bod kyi skad yig slob 'khrid byed stangs dang slob 'khrid kyi dus tshod tshun nas zhib phra'i ngang gtan 'bebs gnang yod par ma zad/ slob 'khrid las don gyi dngos yod dgos mkhor dmigs te tha na dge rgan gso skyong dang / slob deb bkod sgrig bcas kyi thad la'ang zhib phra'i lam ston gnang yod/gtan 'bebs des bod mi rigs kyis bod kyi skad yig bed spyod dang 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i thob thang dang rang dbang la sngar bas brtsi 'jog dang 'gan len byas yod cing /gtan 'bebs de lag len byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob gso'i khyab khongs khrod bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas bcas gang legs byung ba dang chabs cig /spyi tshogs kyi las rigs gzhan du'ang bkol spyod dang 'phel rgyas byung ste/ bod rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor dang rig gzhung gong 'phel 'byung bar skul 'khrid byas nas mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon dang /spyi tshogs brtan po'i ngang 'phel rgyas 'gro ba/mi dmangs mang tshogs blo bde bag phebs ngang 'tsho gnas thub pa byung ste/ rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs kyis rgyab skyor dang bsngags brjod thob par ma zad/ bod kyi skad yig dar rgyas gong spel btang ba'i rnam pa gsar pa bskrun pa des rgyal spyi'i thog shugs rkyen bzang po zhig thebs yod pa dang /de'i rkyen gyis mi dmangs kyi khe phan 'gan srung thub yod la rgyal khab kyi khe phan yang srung skyong thub pa byung yod/der brten/ nga tsho'i bsam 'char la/ bod yig ched sbyong tshan khag gi khyab khongs gang myur gzhi rgya che ru gtong dgos/ de yang rim pa khag dang rig tshan khag gi mtho rim dang 'bring rim ched las slob grwa'i nang de mtshungs kyi spyi tshogs tshan rig slob tshan dang / rang byung tshan rig sogs kyi bod yig ched las slob tshan gsar 'dzugs gnang dgos pa dang / rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi dmangs kyi bu phrug rnams slob chung dang slob 'bring nas mthar phyin rjes/de mtshungs kyi slob grwa dang de mtshungs kyi ched las 'dems kha rang 'dod ltar byas chog pa'i 'gan lenatan tig byed thub pa byas te/ bod ljongs kyi las rigs khag so so'i 'dzugs skrun mi sna gso skyong dang / rgyal khab kyi slob gso'i thon khungs/ shes ldan mi sna'i thon khungs/ rgyu

358 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/nor gyi thon khungs bcas mig sman mig thog tu phan par bed spyod btang nas 'cham mthun dang brtan po'i ngang gong 'phel 'gro ba'i spyi tshogs kyi khor yug cig bskrun dgos/rgya nag nang sa'i bod ljongs slob 'bring gi 'dzin grwa khag tu'ang bod kyi skad yig thog slob 'khrid byed rgyur shugs snon brgyab dgos/bzhi pa/ bod kyi skad yig bkol spyod kyi khyab khongs gsar gtod byas te/ bod kyi skad yig bed spyod dang 'phel rgyas su gtong bar mthun rkyen legs po zhig bskrun dgos/bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong byed pa'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul ni skad yig bed spyod byed rgyu de yin zhing / bod kyi skad yig bed spyod gtong ba'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul ni bod kyi skad yig gong spel gtong rgyu de yin/ bod kyi skad dang yi ge 'di nyid bod ljongs mi rigs khag dang las rigs khag gi nang bkol spyod rgya cher byed thub pa dang / dus rabs gsar pa'i 'og gong spel gsar pa zhig 'byung ched/ phyi lo 1987 lo'i gtan 'bebs kyi don tshan bzhi pas/ljongs nang khul gyi rdzong yan /rdzong tshud )gyi tang srid las khungs dang mi dmangs tshogs pa/ bya gzhag tshan pa (tshags khang dang sman khang / dngul khang / sbrags khang lta bu sogs la zer/ sgyur mchan/)bcas kyis ljongs nang khul du gtong rgyu'i yig cha'i rigs tshang ma bod yig gtso bor byed pa'i thog /bod rgya yig rigs gnyis bed spyod byed dgos/ khe las tshan pas ljongs nang khul du spel rgyu'i yig cha rnams kyang rim pas bod rgya yig rigs gnyis ka yod pa byed rgyu/don tshan lnga pa'i nang du/ ljongs nang khul du rdzong yan (rdzong tshud )gyi tang srid las khungs dang mi dmangs tshogs pa/ bya gzhag tshan pa bcas kyis tshogs 'du bskong 'tshogs byed skabs/yig cha dang dpyad yig rnams nges par du bod rgya yig rigs gnyis yod dgos pa dang / gal 'gangs che ba dang gzhi rgya che ba'i tshogs 'du'i thog tshogs 'dur zhugs mkhan bod rigs kyis dngos gzhi'i gtam bshad byed skabs/ nges par du bod skad rgyag dgos pa dang / tshogs 'du'i skad sgyur gyis rgya skad du bsgyur rgyu/ tshogs 'dur zhugs mkhan gzhan gyis rgya skad kyi thog nas dngos gzhi'i gtam bshad byas tshe/ de yang bod skad du bsgyur rgyu/ don tshan zhe bzhi'i nang du/ dngul khang khag gis bod kyi skad yig la brten nas 'gan babs las ka byed phyogs gsal po bstan yod pa dang / don tshan zhe lnga'i nang tshong las dang sbrag khang / dngul tar/ de min zhabs 'dregs las rigs kyis phyi phyogs la 'gan babs byed sgo spel skabs/ zog 'dzin dang rtsis shog /lag 'dzin sogs 'dzin shog tshang ma bod rgya yig rigs gnyis kyi thog nas 'bri rgyu/ don tshan zhe drug nang / sman don sde khag gi thad kur mang tshogs dang 'brel ba

lhan thabs lda pa/ 359yod mkhan sman pa tshos/ 'gan babs las ku'i khyab khongs nang bed spyod gtong dgos pa'i bod rgya skad yig gnyis nges par du byang chub pa zhig shes pa dgos rgyu/ zhes gtan 'bebs gsal po gnang yod par ma zad/ don tshan zhe bdun pa nas lnga bcu pa bar bod rigs dang 'brel ba'i khrims 'dzin las don gyi bkol spyod skad yig nges par du bod kyi skad yig yin dgos pa'i skor 'khod yod/ gong brjod don tshan khag tu bod rang skyong ljongs kyi las rigs khag yongs rdzogs tshud yod pas/des bod kyi skad yig bkol spyod la sdings cha rgya chen po zhig gnang yod/'on kyang gtan 'bebs gsar pas gtan 'bebs rnying pa'i nang gi gal che ba'i don tshan khag nag bsub btang ste/ bod kyi skad yig bkol spyod kyi khyab khongs chung du btang yod/dmigs tshad de'i sgang nas brjod na/ gtan 'bebs gsar pa des gzhung 'brel yig cha'i rnam pa'i thog nas bod kyi skad yig de nyid las rig khag tu bkol spyod gtong bar bkag rgya byas yod la/ bod ljongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis bod yig slob sbyong thad 'dzin pa'i hur brtson rang bzhin dma' ru btang ste/ bod kyi skad dang yi ge bde blag ngang gong spel gtong bar 'gog rkyen byas yod/ der brten/ nga tsho'i re ba la bod rang skyong ljongs kyis gtan 'bebs gsar par bskyar bcos byed skabs/ bod kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dngos yod dgos mkhor bstun te/ phyi lo 1987 lor 'grems bsgrags byas pa'i gtan 'bebs kyi gal che ba'i nang don rnams sor bzhag thog /bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas su gtong bar phan cha yod pa'i don tshan gsar pa bsnan nas bod kyi skad dang yi ge 'di nyid bod rang skyong ljongs kyi las rigs khag yongs rdzogs dang 'tsho ba'i khyab khongs yongs rdzogs su khyab thub pa dang / tang srid las khungs dang khe las sde tshan/ bya gzhag sde tshan bcas kyis las mi gsar bsdu byed dus/ bod yig shes pa de cha rkyen ang dang por 'jog thub thabs byed dgos/ gzhung zhabs gsar bsdu'i yig rgyugs gtong dus bod yig yig rgyugs nges par du gsar snon byed dgos shing / tang srid las khungs dang / mi dmangs tshogs pa/ khe las tshan pa/bya gzhag tshan pa bcas kyis bod yig chu tshad de las byed shes yon can du bsgyur ba'i dgos nges cha rkyen dang gal che'i nang don zhig tu brtsi dgos/lnga pa/ bod kyi skad yig gi go gnas mtho ru btang ste bod kyi skad yig bed spyod dang 'phel rgyas su gtong bar rmang gzhi brtan po bskrun dgos/de yang dang thog g.yon thal bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun gyis/ bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod btang chog pa'i lugs mthun gyi thob thang dang rang dbang la rdung rdeg dang bkag

360 sgyu yul gyi phan bde'i ched du/'gog /mang tshogs la mgo skor gtong ba'i rgyal khab kyi 'brel yod khrims srol dang srid byus dang 'gal ba'i gtam spyod dang byed stangs de rigs yo bsrang byed dgos/ de nas mtho slob rgyugs sprod khrod bod kyi skad yig gi ang thob brgya char lugs mthun min pa'i sgo nas gcog cha byed stangs de yo bsrang byas te/rgya yig dang 'dra mnyam gyi ang thob brgya cha brgya
